jobs.title: Senior GRC Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

Come help us build the world's most trusted on-demand logistics engine for delivery! We're building a team of great minds to help us secure and maintain a 24x7, no-downtime, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash's multi-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and drivers.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior GRC Engineer to help take DoorDash's compliance program from something people run to something the platform runs on its own. Reporting to the Security Compliance Manager, you'll take primary ownership of how regulatory and framework change gets tracked, interpreted, and turned into real controls - one part of a broader GRC function that spans audit, policy, and risk. Day to day, that means less time updating spreadsheets and more time writing the automation, integrations, and control logic that let audit evidence collect itself. You'll also lead major external audits from start to finish and help shape the policies and control standards the rest of the program is built on.This is a hands-on role for someone who already has deep audit and assurance experience, wants to spend more time building than briefing and can move a program forward, and change how people work, without needing the title to make it happen.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Build the regulatory and framework change-management process that keeps DoorDash ahead of new obligations, instead of reacting to them.
  • Move manual, point-in-time compliance work onto Compliance-as-Code foundations: policy-as-code, automated control testing, and continuous evidence collection wired into CI/CD, so audit readiness holds up between audits, not just during them.
  • Design and run agentic workflows for evidence analysis, control testing, and audit response preparation, with a human in the loop where assurance demands it.
  • Partner directly with engineering and architecture teams to design controls into new systems at build time and translate that technical work into the narratives auditors actually need.
  • Partner with the Security Compliance Manager to shape and mature the global compliance program. 
  • Design, implement and validate security controls relevant to DoorDash's regulatory environment, not just document them.
  • Support development and refinement of security policies, standards, and guidance. 
  • Mentor other members of the compliance team and help set the technical bar the rest of the function grows into.
  • Ensure policies are actionable, testable, and aligned to real-world controls. 

We're excited about you because you have…

  • 5+ years of experience in security compliance, GRC or technology risk, with a strong track record in high-growth, technology-driven and regulated environments. 
  • Hands-on experience building large language models and agent workflows with daily use of AI in your own work, grounded judgment on what to delegate to agents versus what needs a human, and the ability to evidence both to an auditor. DoorDash is an AI-forward organization and the ability to optimize efficiency using AI is crucial in this role.
  • The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with frameworks such as DORA, the EU AI Act, NIS2 and CRA. 
  • Real, hands-on experience implementing and assessing controls against frameworks like PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001 - not just reading them.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify control gaps, assess risk and drive remediation in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. 
  • Experience developing, implementing and improving security policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring they are operational and effective.
  • Strong understanding of compliance metrics and reporting, with the ability to track control effectiveness, audit outcomes, and risk exposure. 
  • Ability to influence and drive accountability across technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex audit and compliance requirements into clear, actionable guidance. 
  • Comfort owning compliance metrics and reporting - you can show, not just assert, that a program is working.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

We're looking for a talented individual to join our Rider Onboarding and Compliance Team. This is the perfect opportunity to join an exciting, fast-growing business and expand your operational abilities.

You will report to the Rider Compliance Team Lead and collaborate with the Rider Compliance Team to proactively ensure riders remain in-service and compliant by effectively and efficiently managing compliance pipelines. In collaboration with the Rider Compliance Senior team, you will be responsible for reducing rider downtime resulting from compliance processes and ensuring Deliveroo is compliant with local laws at all times

What you'll be doing:

Accurately load riders to compliance sweeps to ensure we have valid and compliant rider information and documentation

Monitor the rider compliance flows to ensure minimal friction in the process 

Provide SME compliance knowledge to Deliveroo team to ensure we successfully launch in new markets and our fleet remains compliant

Manage vendor compliance queues to ensure that compliance cases are reviewed and actioned efficiently

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Myyrmäen alueelle Vantaalle
jobs.description: **Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Myyrmäen alueelle.**Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi – työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.**Tarjoamme sinulle**- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A - Kohtaamisia erilaisten ihmisten kanssa - Joustavan työajan - Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa oman työsi sisältöön - Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan - Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan - Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen - Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin **Toivomme sinulta**- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan - Positiivista ja iloista asennetta - Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi - Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi **Edellytämme sinulta**- Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä - Rikosrekisteriotteen esittämistä sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi.

jobs.title: Butikksjef søkes til 7-Eleven Tromsø
jobs.description:
Er du klar for nye utfordringer og mer ansvar? Nå har du mulighet til å bli butikksjef ved 7-Eleven Tromsø. Vi søker en selvstendig og engasjert butikksjef som vil få mye ansvar og spennende oppgaver! En god butikksjef i 7-Eleven trives i kontakten med kundene, bak kassa, elsker å selge mat og drikke til travle kunder, og ikke minst ønsker å være med å motivere de andre medarbeiderne. Du vil få egne ansvarsområder og en mulighet til å påvirke og forme butikken. Erfaringen du får som butikksjef kan åpne muligheter for deg til å gå vårt interne talentprogram, og en dag kunne drive din egen butikk. Du har gjerne jobbet noen år i butikk eller innen salg, men vi søker først og fremst en person som er glad i mennesker, har masse engasjement og som liker å ha ansvar.

Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

7-Eleven bygger på en enkel amerikansk idé: Å være der kundene er og holde åpent når det passer kundene. Med 7-Eleven i nærheten er du derfor garantert en skikkelig energiboost - døgnet rundt! Hos oss finner man et stort utvalg av smakfull mat, spennende nyheter, kalde og varme drikker.

jobs.title: AP/AR Specialist till Nordaq
jobs.description: Vill du utvecklas inom redovisning i ett svenskt bolag med internationell expansion och ett tydligt fokus på kvalitet och hållbarhet?Nu söker vi en AP/AR Specialist till Nordaq - ett innovativt företag som producerar vattenfiltreringslösningar i världsklass och befinner sig på en spännande tillväxtresa internationellt.Om rollenI den här rollen får du en varierad och utvecklande vardag där du arbetar med löpande redovisning med tyngdpunkt på kund- och leverantörsreskontra och samtidigt får möjlighet att bredda din kompetens genom att stötta inköps- och logistikteamet. Du blir en viktig del av ekonomifunktionen och får arbeta nära verksamheten i ett bolag där samarbete och kvalitet genomsyrar allt de gör.De har nyligen implementerat ett nytt ekonomisystem Rootstock, vilket innebär att du får möjlighet att vara med och påverka arbetssätt, rutiner och processer- och bidra till att skapa effektiva flöden som underlättar det dagliga arbetet.Du kommer framför allt att arbeta nära Redovisningsansvarig samt Head of Accounting och ha kontakt med kollegor både i Sverige och internationellt. Har du kunskaper i franska, är det en stor merit, då du kommer att ha mycket utbyte med det franska finansteamet.Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kommer att vara: •    Kund- och leverantörsreskontra•    Löpande bokföring och kontoavstämningar•    Medverkan i bokslutsarbete•    Administrativt stöd till logistik och försäljning, exempelvis genom att skapa och hantera säljordrar i Salesforce•    Logistikhantering, dvs. kontakt med Nordaqs:s hubbar vid packning och skeppning av ordrarVem är du 💜För att trivas hos Nordaq tror vi att du är en person som vill utvecklas, tar ansvar och gillar att arbete med siffror och i nära samarbete och kontakt med kollegor. jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Hämeenlinnaan
jobs.description: Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Hämeenlinnaan.Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.**Tarjoamme sinulle**- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A - Joustavan työajan - Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan - Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan - Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen - Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin **Toivomme sinulta**- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan - Positiivista ja iloista asennetta - Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi - Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain **48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa** sekä **55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä**. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteensosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi**Rekrytoinnin eteneminen**Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme **Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.**Hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen sinut kutsutaan chat-pohjaiseen haastatteluun virtuaalisen rekrytointiassistenttimme Hubertin kanssa. Haastattelu kestää noin 15-20 minuuttia, ja voit tehdä sen sinulle sopivana aikana. Suosittelemme kuitenkin aloittamaan sen pian, jotta rekrytointi etenee sujuvasti. Tekoälypohjainen haastattelu toimii vain tukityökaluna, kaikki lopulliset arviot ja päätökset tekee ihminen.

About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, & designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, & AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, & Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, & a fast-growing global community.

About The Role

Most of Kestra's pipeline starts with someone who already found us: a demo request, a Kestra Cloud trial, a webinar sign-up, or an engineer from the open-source community who wants to talk to Sales. We sell Kestra Enterprise, self-hosted in the customer's own infrastructure, & Kestra Cloud, our fully managed edition.

We're looking for our first inbound Sales Development Representative in Europe to turn that interest into qualified pipeline. You follow up on every inbound lead, qualify it honestly against our Ideal Customer Profile, & pass it to the right Account Executive.

You work closely with our Lead Growth Engineering team, who build & run the systems that capture, score, & route our inbound demand. Together you decide which signals matter, tighten routing, & make sure no good lead goes cold. You report to the Head of Sales & hand off daily to our European Account Executives.

Your buyers are technical: data engineers, platform engineers, & the leaders who run those teams. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be curious enough to learn the product & talk credibly about orchestration.

Follow-up

  • Every inbound lead routed to you: demo & contact requests, Kestra Cloud trials & sign-ups, event & webinar follow-ups, & community hand-raises.

  • Messages that read like a person wrote them: short, relevant, & clearly based on what the prospect actually asked for.

Qualification

  • Qualification calls that uncover the prospect's use case, current tooling (Airflow, cron, homegrown scripts, cloud-native schedulers), team, & timeline.

  • Feedback on lead quality by source, campaign, & persona, so scoring & routing keep improving.

  • Spotting gaps early: leads routed to the wrong place, signals the system misses, or steps that slow a prospect down.

  • 1+ year as an SDR, BDR, or in a similar customer-facing role, ideally at a B2B SaaS or software company.

jobs.description:
About the Science and AI Team

The Science and AI team is at the heart of Maki People. It builds the science and AI behind our platform, from job analysis and assessments to AI interviews and predicting performance. Led by our Head of Science, Aiden Loe, and working closely with our COO, Paul-Louis Caylar, the team brings together business psychologists, psychometricians and AI scientists. Together, they make sure every hiring decision on our platform is accurate, consistent and fair.

As Maki grows, the Science and AI team’s job is to show, with evidence, that our approach leads to better hiring decisions.

 

About the Role

The AI Applied Scientist turns our science into results for clients. Most of your time goes on client projects: adapting our AI scoring to each client’s roles, analysing their data, and showing them what it means. The rest goes on improving the scoring systems that every client relies on.

1. Client projects

  • Adapt AI scoring for structured interviews, job-specific skills and multilingual proficiency to each client’s roles and needs.

  • Analyse client assessment and performance data to show how scores relate to job performance and retention.

  • Set and review cut-offs and thresholds with clients, backed by evidence.

  • Present findings and recommendations directly to clients, in a way non-technical audiences can act on.

  • Work closely with implementation and customer success teams from setup to go-live.

2. Testing scoring quality

  • Compare AI scores with expert ratings to check accuracy and reliability before anything goes live.

  • Test robustness to prompt variation, input noise and adversarial behaviour such as prompt injection.

3. Fairness in practice

  • Run bias checks across demographic groups for each client project.

  • Apply mitigation techniques such as reweighting and calibration without losing model performance.

  • Support fairness reports and compliance documentation for clients.

4. Improving our scoring systems

  • Help choose the right models and prompts for production, balancing accuracy, speed and cost.

  • Support the move onto self-hosted open-weight models, including fine-tuning on expert-rated data.

  • Work with engineering to roll out scoring changes safely.

As one of Maki People’s early employees, you’ll help shape the team’s future.


Our Ideal Candidate

Required

  • MSc or PhD in data science, machine learning, psychology or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.

  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based scoring or evaluation.

  • Strong Python or R skills, with solid statistical analysis.

  • Experience presenting data-driven findings to clients or senior business stakeholders.

  • Able to manage several projects at once and keep to deadlines.

Preferred

  • Experience in consulting, people analytics or assessment.

  • Working knowledge of psychometric concepts such as reliability, validity and IRT.

  • Experience testing AI systems for fairness and bias.

  • Experience fine-tuning language models, for example with LoRA.

  • Working knowledge of ethical AI and compliance, such as the EU AI Act.

     

Application Process

  • Stage 1 - Screening assessment (25 min)

  • Stage 2 - Power skill assessment with our AI agent (15 min)

  • Stage 3 - Hiring manager interview (45 min)

  • Stage 4 - Executive interview (45 min)

  • Stage 5 - Deep-dive technical interview (60 min)

  • Stage 6 - Interview with Co-founder (30 min)

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) - Saas Santé
jobs.description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

⚡ Notre équipe Sales Public

L’équipe Sales Public accompagne les établissements de santé dans l’adoption des solutions Lifen, principalement autour de la gestion des documents de santé. Elle compte aujourd’hui 8 Sales Account Executive qui travaillent sur l’ensemble du territoire.

Les Sales concentrent aujourd’hui leur temps sur les plus grands établissements et groupements hospitaliers. À côté, il existe un vivier d’environ 800 structures de santé de plus petite taille.

Nous créons donc notre premier poste de SDR Public. Ton rôle sera de construire ce périmètre : mieux connaître ces structures, trouver les personnes à contacter, qualifier les opportunités et transmettre aux Sales des rendez-vous réellement exploitables. Tu travailleras principalement sur nos offres Lifen Documents et Curecall by Lifen.

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

  • Prioriser un portefeuille d’environ 800 petites structures de santé déjà cartographiée.

  • Entrer en contact avec les prospects, comprendre leur contexte et qualifier les opportunités avant de proposer un échange avec un ou une Sales Account Executive.

  • Générer des rendez-vous qualifiés pour l’équipe Sales, en transmettant les informations utiles pour permettre une prise de relais efficace.

  • Mettre à jour le CRM avec rigueur : contacts, informations sur les structures, niveau de maturité des opportunités et prochaines étapes.

  • Faire progresser les méthodes de prospection sur ce nouveau périmètre : messages, séquences, critères de qualification et priorisation des comptes.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

  • Une première expérience de cold call intensive (Stage, Alternance ou CDI), idéalement d’un à deux ans en startup, en SDR, Inside Sales, prospection B2B ou relation client.

  • Une vraie appétence pour la prospection : prendre contact, obtenir les bonnes informations, relancer et transformer une approche en rendez-vous qualifié.

  • La capacité à organiser un volume important de comptes, à prioriser et à tenir un suivi précis dans un CRM.

  • Une communication orale et écrite claire, adaptée à des interlocuteurs de direction de structures de santé.

Nice-to-have

  • Une expérience dans la santé ou auprès de professionnels et d’établissements de santé.

  • La pratique d’outils de CRM et de prospection.

Soft skills

Tu es énergique et tu aimes avancer sur un périmètre à construire. Tu communiques simplement, tu écoutes avant de proposer un rendez-vous et tu acceptes les retours pour ajuster ta manière de faire. L’humilité compte : tu travailleras avec une équipe Sales expérimentée et tu sauras apprendre à ses côtés tout en apportant tes propres observations du terrain.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity. Tu avances dans un secteur de santé complexe et sur un portefeuille encore peu structuré, en transformant progressivement des informations éparses en opportunités qualifiées.

Bienveillance. Tu collabores étroitement avec les Sales, dans une équipe où l’entraide et le partage d’informations font partie du quotidien.

Real Impact. Chaque rendez-vous qualifié peut contribuer à équiper davantage de structures de santé avec des outils qui simplifient la circulation des documents.

👥 Process de recrutement

Le process est volontairement court et se déroulera principalement en visio.

  1. TAM Screening avec l’équipe recrutement - Environ 30 minutes. L’objectif est de comprendre ton parcours, ta motivation pour le poste et d’évaluer les fondamentaux attendus : communication, énergie, organisation et posture commerciale.

  2. Case study avec l’équipe Sales - Un entretien en visio d’1h comprenant la restitution de deux exercices préparés à l’avance et la réalisation de deux exercices en direct. Le cas sera envoyé environ deux jours avant l’échange et demandera environ 1h de préparation. Il permettra d’évaluer ta capacité à prioriser, à structurer une approche de prospection et à communiquer avec clarté.

  3. Final Interview - Un entretien avec un Manager de l’équipe Sales pour valider l’alignement culturel.

Nous nous engageons à te donner de la visibilité tout au long du process et à revenir vers toi sous 72h après chaque étape. Des prises de références pourront être demandées en fin de process, avec ton accord.

Soigner mieux en soignant ensemble, c'est aussi agir avec bienveillance. À l'image du secteur dans lequel nous évoluons, nous favorisons la diversité, l'inclusion et l'équité. Nous mettons en valeur vos compétences et votre savoir-faire, et bannissons toute forme de discrimination, qu'elle soit sexuelle, religieuse ou politique.

Compensation: €35K • €0 – €10.5K Commission

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

 

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

     

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

     

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

     

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

jobs.title: Founding Product
jobs.description:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. In reality, hundred of thousands of operators acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on, with tools that have barely changed in decades and spending hours a day on email. Nexcade is building the agentic operating system for those people, transforming the way people communicate and optimise the $1T spend on logistics every year.

Our agents are live in production with leading global Freight Forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are rapidly expanding the platform to touch every part of the logistics lifecycle.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality from top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

  • Everybody builds, founders included. The whole company is technical and runs on coding agents. You will not be asked to write production software, but you will use agents for discovery synthesis, specs, prototypes and data analysis rather than doing them by hand.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role

We’re building the AI platform freight forwarders rely on. We started with quoting and are expanding across the shipment lifecycle. As Product Lead, you will be central to that expansion, helping decide where we focus and turning those decisions into products customers depend on.

What you’ll do:

  • Own product outcomes: Own the roadmap, priorities and performance of specific products, from defining the customer problem through launch, rollout and adoption. Partner with the founders on overall product direction and strategy.

  • Build from customer insight: Work closely with freight forwarders across commercial and operational roles. Understand how they work, identify the problems customers share and build products for those needs rather than one-off solutions.

  • Prototype and build: Turn ideas into working prototypes and early product versions, using AI tools and code to test them with customers. Work hands-on with engineering to take promising ideas into production, not just write specs and hand them over.

  • Drive product expansion: Build a clear view of the market, including where we win, where we do not compete and why customers choose us. Use that understanding to identify the next workflows Nexcade should enter and turn them into products that grow revenue.

  • Raise the standard of product thinking: Define success measures, test assumptions and examine accuracy, edge cases and second-order effects before scaling. Write clear specs and decision documents, including a written recommendation on the hard calls.

  • Build the product operating system: Establish a clear planning and decision-making cadence without adding bureaucracy. Make sure product meetings are well prepared, teams have the context they need and decisions translate into shipped work.

  • Make product and platform trade-offs: Work closely with engineering to decide when to invest in shared capabilities and when a faster, product-specific approach is right.

What we look for

  • Strong product judgement: You have owned meaningful product work in a complex B2B product and can show how your decisions changed customer behaviour or business results. You define success clearly and test assumptions, accuracy and edge cases before scaling.

  • Product taste: You can turn complex workflows into products that feel simple, coherent and trustworthy. You care about the details that make people choose to use them.

  • Technical fluency: You work effectively with strong engineers, understand trade-offs across architecture, AI, data and integrations and bring the customer and product perspective to choices about speed, quality and reuse.

  • Excellent judgement: You get beyond what customers ask for to understand how their work really happens and distinguish repeatable needs from bespoke requests. You use customer and market insight to make product choices that drive adoption, expansion and revenue.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

In this role, you will act as the primary point of contact for our largest hospitality customers in France.   • Plan and lead quarterly business reviews and success plans

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with C-level and operational stakeholders, positioning Lightspeed as a long-term strategic partner

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, Implementation, and Support teams to deliver an excellent customer experience

  • Collect customer feedback and proactively share it with relevant teams to identify product gaps and optimize the overall customer journey

  • A strong understanding of SaaS metrics (NRR, product adoption, expansion, renewals, churn) and the ability to use them to manage your portfolio

  • A strong sense of ownership; you are hands-on, data-driven, and highly skilled in relationship management

  • Experience managing complex, multi-level stakeholder structures and confidently engaging with C-level, operations, and technical teams

  • Fluent business-level French and English

  • Experience in the hospitality, POS, or hospitality tech industry is a plus, but not required


What’s in it for you?

Come live the Lightspeed experience…

  • Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day

  • Work in a team large enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact

  • Exposure to modern and proven technology

  • Ability to work and grow in a truly flexible environment

  • Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform

  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year 

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Health insurance with attractive guarantee plans

 

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

jobs.title: Account Executive, France
jobs.description:
NetBox Labs is seeking a Senior Account Executive (AE) to play a pivotal role in the growth and expansion of our business. You will be tasked with proactive outbound prospecting and managing inbound leads. Given the technical nature of our product, a high technical aptitude is crucial to understand and articulate the value proposition effectively to potential clients. You will be responsible for the entire sales cycle, including the initial prospecting, qualification, technical discussions, pricing and contract negotiation, deal closure, and expansion. This role demands a combination of technical understanding, sales acumen, and relationship-building skills to drive significant impact and contribute to the company's success.

 

In this role, you will:

 

  • Proactively build, qualify, and close a new logo sales pipeline, ensuring you meet or exceed quota and drive steady bookings growth.

  • Be responsible for outbound motions to create pipeline.

  • Strategically prospect into Network Engineering management & technical end users, understanding their unique challenges and requirements.

  • Build strong and effective relationships with prospects using a consultative sales approach, leading to increased trust and deal velocity.

  • Work on both the acquisition of net new customers and the revenue expansion of existing customer accounts.

  • Work with the Channel team to develop indirect opportunities.

  • Work with the Customer Success team for expansion into existing accounts.

  • Build and manage accurate forecast and opportunity progress reporting.

  • Partner with our Solutions Engineers to ensure technical alignment and convey NetBox Labs’ value proposition and key differentiators.

  • Continually seek to improve your selling skills and iterate/improve on the sales process.

  • Develop an understanding of the partner ecosystem and competitive solutions.

 
 

Requirements:

 

  • 5+ years of SaaS/Networking Equipment field experience with quota-carrying roles in fast-paced markets, focused on closing net new logos and demonstrating the ability to run complex sales processes. Experience working with open source technology is a plus.

  • 1+ years of experience working in a collaborative startup environment.

  • An entrepreneurial and self-starter mentality with the ability to roll up your sleeves and get involved with many aspects of selling to “get it done”

  • A history of overachievement and consistently hitting or exceeding sales targets.

  • Proficiency in managing both inbound leads and outbound prospecting to build a robust pipeline.

  • Drive and competitiveness, underlined by a strong desire to win.

  • Technical aptitude and exceptional ability to articulate the business value of complex, technical enterprise products built on open source technology. Previous experience as a sales engineer or network engineer is a plus.

  • Specialized knowledge in Networking, Network Engineering, Network Automation would be a significant advantage.

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

 

Compensation: €70K – €85K • Offers Equity • €70K – €85K Bonus

jobs.title: Trondheim Montessoriskole søker en engasjert, kreativ og inspirerende lærer til et 1-årig vikariat på ungdomstrinnet!
jobs.description:
Vil du inspirere ungdom til å lære, utforske og utvikle sitt potensial? Trondheim Montessoriskole søker en engasjert lærer til et 1 års vikariat. Hos oss får du arbeide med montessoripedagogikk, bygge sterke relasjoner og bidra til å forme et inkluderende og framtidsrettet læringsmiljø.

Hva vi ser etter Vi ser etter deg som

  • Har godkjent lærerutdanning og undervisningskompetanse for ungdomstrinnet.

  • Har et genuint engasjement for ungdom og deres utvikling.

  • Er nysgjerrig på, eller har erfaring med, montessoripedagogikk.

  • Er en trygg, tydelig og relasjonsorientert voksen.

  • Har evne til å skape motivasjon, mestring og lærelyst.

  • Er kreativ, fleksibel og liker å tenke nytt om læring.

  • Er strukturert og har gode samarbeidsevner.

  • Ser muligheter og ressurser i hver enkelt elev.

Montessoriutdanning eller erfaring fra Montessoriskole er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Vi er opptatt av å finne den rette personen som ønsker å lære, utvikle seg og bidra til vårt pedagogiske fellesskap.

Arbeidsoppgaver Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Planlegge og gjennomføre undervisning i tråd med montessoripedagogikken og læreplan.

  • Skape et inspirerende, inkluderende og faglig stimulerende læringsmiljø.

  • Veilede ungdom i deres faglige, sosiale og personlige utvikling.

  • Tilrettelegge for differensiert undervisning og individuelt tilpassede læringsprosesser.

  • Støtte elevenes selvstendighet, ansvarlighet, samarbeid og kritiske tenkning.

  • Bidra aktivt til pedagogisk utvikling og samarbeid i skolens profesjonelle læringsfellesskap.

  • Delta i et tett og konstruktivt samarbeid med kolleger og foresatte.

Vi tilbyr

Vi søker deg som ønsker å gjøre en forskjell -- ikke bare gjennom det du lærer bort, men gjennom måten du møter ungdom på.

Hos oss får du muligheten til å inspirere, utfordre og støtte ungdom i en viktig fase av livet. Sammen skaper vi et læringsmiljø der elevene får vokse, utforske og oppdage hva de kan bli. Vi tilby:

  • En meningsfull og spennende arbeidshverdag med ungdom i utvikling.

  • Muligheten til å arbeide med en helhetlig og elevsentrert pedagogikk.

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og dedikerte kolleger.

  • Mulighet for faglig og pedagogisk utvikling.

  • En skolekultur preget av samarbeid, respekt, tillit og fellesskap.

  • Muligheten til å bidra aktivt til videre utvikling av Montessori ungdomsskole.

  • Lønn og arbeidsvilkår i henhold til gjeldende tariffavtale.

  • Pensjonsordning gjennom Statens pensjonskasse (SPK), med gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

  • Trygge og forutsigbare arbeidsvilkår i en skole med tariffavtale.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Trondheim Montessoriskole er en friskole som bygger på Maria Montessoris pedagogiske filosofi og verdier. Vi tror på barn og ungdoms iboende evne til å lære, utvikle seg og ta ansvar når de møtes med respekt, tillit og gode rammer.

Vår pedagogikk bygger på helhetlig utvikling, selvstendighet, faglig fordypning og læringsglede. Vi legger vekt på å se det enkelte mennesket, skape inkluderende fellesskap og tilrettelegge for at hver elev kan utvikle sitt potensial, både faglig, sosialt og personlig.

Hos oss er læring mer enn undervisning. Vi ønsker å utvikle nysgjerrige, reflekterte og selvstendige mennesker som opplever mestring, tilhørighet og ansvar for egen læring.

Vi er et engasjert pedagogisk fellesskap som arbeider med kontinuerlig utvikling av montessoripraksis, og som verdsetter samarbeid, faglig refleksjon og respekt for den enkelte.

Vil du være med på å forme fremtidens læringsmiljø? Hos oss får du muligheten til å gjøre en forskjell hver dag!

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Imatralle
jobs.description: **Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Imatralle.**Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.**Tarjoamme sinulle**- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A - Joustavan työajan - Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan - Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan - Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen - Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin **Toivomme sinulta**- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan - Positiivista ja iloista asennetta - Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi - Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi**Rekrytoinnin eteneminen**Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.Hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen sinut kutsutaan chat-pohjaiseen haastatteluun virtuaalisen rekrytointiassistenttimme Hubertin kanssa. Haastattelu kestää noin 15-20 minuuttia, ja voit tehdä sen sinulle sopivana aikana. Suosittelemme kuitenkin aloittamaan sen pian, jotta rekrytointi etenee sujuvasti. Tekoälypohjainen haastattelu toimii vain tukityökaluna, kaikki lopulliset arviot ja päätökset tekee ihminen.

jobs.title: Deviseur SAV - Luxembourg (Bonnevoie) (H/F)
jobs.description: Salaire : 48 000,00€ à 53 000,00€ par anDescription du poste :Deviseur-se SAV - Cuisines professionnelles / Bonnevoie, LuxembourgVous êtes technicien-ne de terrain expérimenté-e et souhaitez évoluer vers un poste sédentaire, tout en restant au cœur des sujets techniques ? Rejoignez une entreprise familiale en pleine croissance, spécialisée dans l'installation et la maintenance d'équipements de cuisines professionnelles et privées.Basé-e à Bonnevoie, vous travaillerez au cœur de l'activité SAV, en lien avec les techniciens, les fournisseurs et les clients.Critères indispensablesAu moins 5 ans d'expérience comme technicien-ne de terrain - une expérience comme deviseur-se n'est pas nécessaire.Une solide base technique dans au moins un de ces domaines : cuisine professionnelle, froid, électromécanique, électricité ou plomberie. Une expérience dans plusieurs de ces domaines est un plus.Un niveau de français suffisant pour communiquer clairement à l'oral comme à l'écrit.Une bonne aisance avec les outils informatiques : ERP, Excel, messagerie et rédaction de documents.La possibilité de vous rendre chaque jour sur le site de Bonnevoie : le poste est sédentaire et aucun véhicule n'est fourni.Votre missionVous analyserez les demandes d'intervention et les rapports des techniciens, puis chiffrerez les réparations, opérations de maintenance et remplacements d'équipements. Votre objectif : proposer des offres claires, fiables et compétitives, tout en veillant à la satisfaction des clients et à la rentabilité des dossiers.Au quotidien, vous serez amené-e àÉtudier les demandes de dépannage et évaluer la faisabilité des réparations ;Chiffrer les pièces, la main-d'œuvre, les déplacements et les éventuelles sous-traitances ;Rechercher des solutions de remplacement lorsque des pièces ne sont plus disponibles ;Consulter les fournisseurs et négocier les prix et les délais ;Rédiger des devis détaillés et en assurer le suivi ;Transmettre les dossiers complets à l'équipe de planification après validation des offres.Votre profilVous appréciez l'analyse technique et les échanges avec les clients et les fournisseurs. Une connaissance des équipements de cuisine - froid commercial, cuisson, ventilation ou laverie - sera particulièrement appréciée.Vous êtes reconnu-e pour votre rigueur, votre sens de l'organisation, votre réactivité et votre capacité à gérer les priorités. La connaissance des normes de sécurité liées au gaz, à l'électricité et aux fluides frigorigènes constitue un atout.Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel et Word. La pratique d'un ERP, d'une GPAO ou d'un CRM est également appréciée.Ce que le poste vous offreUn poste sédentaire, sans interventions quotidiennes sur le terrain ;Une formation de plusieurs mois, accompagnée par un deviseur expérimenté ;Un métier technique et varié, idéal pour développer votre expertise ;Une équipe SAV soudée, composée de collaborateurs au bureau et sur le terrain ;La stabilité d'une entreprise familiale en bonne santé, avec une activité soutenue ;De nouveaux locaux prévus prochainement, desservis par les bus ;Une possibilité de télétravail à envisager après la première année.LieuBonnevoie, Luxembourg-VilleProcessus de recrutementLe recrutement comprend un premier échange téléphonique, suivi d'une rencontre en présentiel avec l'équipe. Aucun test technique n'est prévu.Lieu du poste : En présentiel

jobs.title: Senior Visual Designer
jobs.description:
At Dyflexis, we help millions of employees worldwide with our workforce management software. From the bakery around the corner to international hotel and retail chains. The software is powerful, customer questions are diverse, and no two days are the same. You'll get to know the product inside out and contribute to something that's growing rapidly in more than 20 countries.


How do we do it? We work in a fast-paced environment with short communication lines. There are no unnecessary meetings and no politics. Our Focus? Ownership, clear communication, and getting things done together. We move quickly, learn by doing, and continuously improve how we support our customers. As our Senior Visual Designer, you'll take our visual identity and our website to the next level, and help build a brand that matches our ambitions. Nothing is set in stone, and there's a lot we want to build.


This is what you'll do

Your work is often the first thing a hotel chain or a bakery sees of us, usually on a screen: our website, a campaign, a landing page. You'll shape how Dyflexis looks and feels everywhere and take the brand from consistent to unmistakable. You'll work closely with our Brand Designer, the Marketing team, and UX/UI colleagues. You bring creative ideas, design thinking and a strong eye for digital. You turn business goals into concepts, carry one strong idea through every touchpoint, and know how to win people over with your work.

  • Take our visual identity further: typography, colour, imagery, illustration and motion, into a bold language that works in every market and language we're in.

  • Bring dyflexis.com to the next level: layouts, landing pages and the visual side of the user journey, together with the Product team.

  • Design campaigns, social, ads, landing pages and sales materials that are on brand and on point. You keep the brand sharp in the everyday work, and you make it better every time.

  • Turn business goals into creative concepts and help shape where the brand goes next. Bring design thinking to the table and help shape where the brand goes next, together with marketing, sales and product.

  • Win people over. Present your ideas to colleagues and leadership, and handle feedback from many stakeholders without losing the idea.

  • Use AI for creative exploration and enhance your workflow and spend your time on making the work exceptional.

This is what you'll need

  • 5+ years in visual, digital or brand design.

  • A portfolio that shows strong creative ideas and visual systems, not just single pieces. B2B work isn't required. Great work is.

  • A strong eye for digital: web design, layout, typography and detail.

  • Interest in product design and design thinking.

  • Mastery of Figma and Adobe CC. Motion skills (After Effects or similar) are a plus.Experience with Framer is a big plus as well

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools, and the curiosity to keep finding new ways to work better.

  • The ambition to grow the brand with us, and the confidence to explain your choices to a fellow designer and to a CEO.

Please note: this is not an art director or brand director role, or a role for a 3D, photography, video production or motion-only specialist.


What you'll get

At Dyflexis, you'll be part of an ambitious, energetic, and customer-focused team. We offer:

  • Fixed salary up to €6,000 gross per month based on a 40-hour week (experience based).

  • A MacBook Pro to do your best design work.

  • Personal development budget to level up your skills.

  • 25 vacation days plus your birthday off in exchange for cake.

  • An in-house chef surprising you daily with fresh lunch.

  • The best parties, drinks and trips (Winter sports, Ibiza and more).

  • Membership at ARJ Training boxing gym (home of champion Tarik and Levi Rigters).

  • Solid pension plan and 8% holiday allowance.

  • Buy or sell vacation days, you decide.

  • Travel allowance and WFH compensation.

  • Friday chair massages to kick off your weekend.

Apply now

Ready to take the Dyflexis brand and website to the next level? Hit apply with your CV and a portfolio of your work. No cover letter needed, we'll ask a few questions and get back to you quickly.

Note: Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated.

jobs.title: Responsable comptable adjoint(e)
jobs.description:
Vous aimez la comptabilité dans toute sa dimension opérationnelle ? Vous appréciez autant la technicité des travaux de clôture que l'analyse des résultats et la fiabilisation des données financières ?

Nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable Comptable Adjoint(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe et accompagner le suivi comptable et financier de notre entreprise et de ses filiales françaises.

Rattaché(e) à la Responsable Administrative et financière, vous occupez un rôle polyvalent et central, associant production comptable, révision des comptes, reporting financier et suivi fiscal. Vous intervenez concrètement dans les opérations du quotidien tout en contribuant aux travaux financiers et aux remontées d'informations destinées au Groupe.

Vos missions

  1. Assurer la gestion comptable au quotidien

  • Réaliser les opérations courantes de comptabilité générale et fournisseurs.

  • Assurer ponctuellement la saisie et l'enregistrement des factures fournisseurs.

  • Effectuer le rapprochement des factures avec les commandes et les réceptions.

  • Contrôler les imputations comptables et analytiques.

  • Participer au suivi et à la justification des comptes.

2. Participer aux clôtures et à la révision des comptes

  • Préparer et contribuer aux clôtures comptables mensuelles et annuelles.

  • Participer à l'élaboration du bilan et du compte de résultat.

  • Réaliser les travaux de révision : justification des comptes, contrôle des écritures, rapprochements et régularisations.

  • Veiller à la fiabilité et à la cohérence des données comptables.

3. Contribuer au reporting et à la consolidation

  • Participer aux travaux de consolidation des comptes du Groupe.

  • Collecter, contrôler et fiabiliser les données financières des différentes entités.

  • Élaborer les reportings périodiques et les tableaux de bord destinés au Responsable Administratif.

  • Participer à l'analyse des résultats et à la préparation des données financières présentées au Groupe.

4. Apporter votre soutien au contrôle de gestion

  • Participer à la préparation et à l'analyse des résultats.

  • Contribuer au suivi des données analytiques et à l'analyse des écarts entre le réalisé et les prévisions.

  • Participer à la fiabilisation des indicateurs de performance.

5. Participer au suivi de la trésorerie et de la fiscalité

  • Contribuer au suivi des flux et des positions de trésorerie des filiales françaises.

  • Participer à l'élaboration des prévisions de trésorerie.

  • Préparer, établir et contrôler les déclarations de TVA et autres déclarations fiscales.

  • Veiller au respect des échéances et des obligations déclaratives.


Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en comptabilité, gestion ou finance, de type DCG, Licence professionnelle ou équivalent (Bac +3 minimum).

Vous justifiez idéalement de plus de 5 années d'expérience minimum en comptabilité générale, acquises de préférence dans un environnement multi-sociétés ou au sein d'une PME structurée.

Vous maîtrisez les mécanismes comptables, les opérations de clôture et de révision ainsi que les obligations fiscales courantes, notamment en matière de TVA.

Une connaissance des processus de consolidation, du reporting financier et du suivi de trésorerie sera particulièrement appréciée.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques, notamment Excel, et savez exploiter des données comptables pour en tirer des analyses fiables.

Au-delà de votre parcours, nous recherchons une personne :

  • Rigoureuse et organisée, attachée à la fiabilité de son travail.

  • Autonome et impliquée, capable de prendre en charge ses missions de bout en bout.

  • Polyvalente, appréciant autant les opérations comptables concrètes que les travaux d'analyse.

  • Dotée d'un bon esprit d'analyse et de synthèse.

  • À l'aise dans les échanges avec différents interlocuteurs et appréciant le travail en équipe.

jobs.title: Senior Medewerker Financiële Administratie
jobs.description:
GGZ inGeest zoekt een senior medewerker Financiële Administratie in Amsterdam.

Als senior medewerker Financiële Administratie ben je verantwoordelijk voor een zorgvuldige uitvoering en bewaking van diverse financiële administratieve processen. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in het waarborgen van de juistheid, volledigheid en tijdigheid van de financiële administratie. Naast de uitvoering van de dagelijkse werkzaamheden analyseer je financiële gegevens, onderzoek je afwijkingen en signaleer je mogelijkheden om processen te optimaliseren. Met jouw expertise draag je bij aan een betrouwbare financiële bedrijfsvoering en een adequate ondersteuning van de organisatie.


Waar ga je werken? 

  • De afdeling Financiële Administratie bestaat uit 10 enthousiaste medewerkers, inclusief de manager Financiële Administratie, en maakt onderdeel uit van de Directie Financiën.

  • De afdeling is verantwoordelijk voor de controle op en de tijdige, juiste en volledige verwerking van financiële gegevens in het financiële systeem.

  • Vanuit jouw financiële expertise ondersteun je de organisatie bij administratieve en financiële vraagstukken. Hiermee ontlast je behandelaren en andere zorgprofessionals, zodat zij zich kunnen richten op hun primaire werkzaamheden.

 Wat ga je doen?

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering en bewaking van de debiteurenadministratie. Hieronder vallen onder andere het verzorgen van facturatie, het controleren van openstaande posten, het versturen van aanmaningen en het bewaken van de volledigheid van de facturatie.

  • Je controleert financiële gegevens in AFAS en voert, indien nodig, correcties door.

  • Je stelt financiële informatie beschikbaar voor interne rapportages en levert een bijdrage aan periodieke afsluitingen en aansluitingen met het grootboek.

  • Je analyseert de financiële en projectadministratie, signaleert onvolkomenheden en doet voorstellen ter verbetering van de administratieve processen.

  • Je voert de financiële administratie van samenwerkingsprojecten in het kader van het Integraal Zorgakkoord (IZA) en van subsidieprojecten.

  • Je analyseert verschillen tussen administratieve gegevens en gerealiseerde resultaten en draagt zorg voor een adequate opvolging.

  • Je fungeert als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor financiële vraagstukken met betrekking tot debiteuren, IZA-samenwerkingsprojecten en subsidieprojecten.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in de richting van financiële administratie, Finance & Control of een vergelijkbare studierichting.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met debiteurenadministratie en projectadministratie.

  • Bij voorkeur ervaring met de financiële administratie en verantwoording van subsidieprojecten en samenwerkingsprojecten.

  • Kennis van financiële verslaglegging en ervaring met het controleren en analyseren van financiële gegevens.

  • Een nauwkeurige en analytische werkwijze, waarbij je oog hebt voor detail en deadlines.

  • Het vermogen om zelfstandig financiële afwijkingen te analyseren, oorzaken te achterhalen en passende oplossingen te realiseren.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een servicegerichte, professionele houding.

  • Een proactieve instelling en affiniteit met het optimaliseren van financiële administratieve processen.

Ook belangrijk 

  • Je komt in het team Financiële Administratie op de Overschiestraat in Amsterdam.  

  • Een afgeronde HBO-opleiding richting financiële administratie is vereist. 

  • De functie is ingeschaald in FWG45 conform CAO GGZ. Je salaris hangt samen met je ervaring  
    We bieden: 

  • Een meerkeuzesysteem aan arbeidsvoorwaarden;

  • Een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%;

  • Flinke korting op een sport abonnement;

  • Korting op één van de collectieve ziektekostenverzekeringen;

  • Bekijk hier alle arbeidsvoorwaarden.

jobs.title: Junior Tester
jobs.description:
Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar hoe software werkt en vind je het leuk om uit te zoeken of alles doet wat het zou moeten doen? Heb je oog voor detail, stel je graag kritische vragen en krijg je energie van het vinden van verbeterpunten?

Dan is deze functie als Junior Tester precies wat je zoekt!

Als tester speel je een belangrijke rol in de kwaliteit van software. Je onderzoekt applicaties, voert testen uit en kijkt kritisch naar de werking ervan. Kom je iets tegen wat niet klopt? Dan analyseer je wat er aan de hand is en zorg je ervoor dat jouw bevindingen duidelijk bij de juiste mensen terechtkomen.

Je hoeft nog geen ervaring te hebben als tester. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je leergierig, analytisch en nauwkeurig bent en graag wilt ontdekken hoe je software steeds beter kunt maken.

Wat ga je doen als Junior Tester?

Als Junior Tester houd je je bezig met het controleren en beoordelen van de werking en kwaliteit van applicaties en systemen. Je werkt samen met ontwikkelaars, analisten en andere betrokken collega's om ervoor te zorgen dat software goed functioneert en voldoet aan de verwachtingen.

Je leert stap voor stap hoe je verschillende soorten testen uitvoert en hoe je bevindingen op een duidelijke manier rapporteert.

Concreet zijn jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Opstellen van testscenario's

  • Uitvoeren van testgevallen

  • Controleren of applicaties werken zoals bedoeld

  • Signaleren van fouten, afwijkingen en verbeterpunten

  • Analyseren van testresultaten en bevindingen

  • Registreren en duidelijk communiceren van bevindingen

  • Samenwerken met developers, analisten en andere stakeholders

  • Meedenken over de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van software

  • Leren werken met verschillende testmethodieken en tools

Je krijgt gedurende het traineeship de ruimte om praktijkervaring op te doen en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Zo groei je stap voor stap van trainee naar een zelfstandige tester.

Binnen het traineeship Business & IT ontwikkel je jezelf in twee jaar tijd tot een echte IT-professional. Je doet direct praktijkervaring op, volgt trainingen en behaalt relevante certificaten die je de rest van je carrière kunt gebruiken.

In het eerste jaar leg je een sterke basis in IT, systemen, processen en communicatie. Vanuit daar ontwikkel je jezelf steeds verder binnen jouw vakgebied.

Je start met een onboarding op ons kantoor in Bunnik, waar je trainingen volgt en je mede-trainees leert kennen. Daarna start je in je rol als Junior Tester. Gedurende het hele traject krijg je begeleiding van een persoonlijke people manager die je helpt om stappen te maken in je ontwikkeling.

  • Een startsalaris tussen de €2600 en €2800

  • Een fulltime functie van 36 tot 40 uur per week

  • De mogelijkheid om jezelf in twee jaar tijd te ontwikkelen tot een zelfstandige IT-professional

  • Hybride werken is mogelijk, waarbij Assen de vaste werklocatie is en je incidenteel ook op de locaties in Zwolle of Den Haag werkt



Voor deze functie vinden we jouw motivatie en ontwikkelpotentieel belangrijker dan een uitgebreid cv. Specifieke werkervaring als tester is dan ook geen vereiste.

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren Electrical Engineer met een passie voor complexe technische gebouwen in de onderzoeks-, onderwijs- en cultuursector? Als Senior Electrical Engineer binnen de Unit Real Estate werk je aan uitdagende en innovatieve projecten waarin techniek, duurzaamheid en maatschappelijke waarde samenkomen. Met jouw technische expertise neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor complexe elektrotechnische ontwerpen, adviseer je opdrachtgevers en deel je jouw kennis met collega’s.

 

De uitdaging 

Als Senior Electrical Engineer ben je onderdeel van de Unit Real Estate en werk je aan het elektrotechnisch ontwerp binnen uitdagende projecten in de onderwijs-, onderzoeks- en cultuursector. Van nieuwbouw en renovatie tot complexe transformatievraagstukken: jij vertaalt de wensen en eisen van de opdrachtgever naar slimme, duurzame en technisch hoogwaardige oplossingen.

Je werkt binnen multidisciplinaire projectteams nauw samen met collega’s vanuit onder andere werktuigbouwkunde, bouwfysica en duurzaamheid. Vanuit jouw ervaring overzie je de samenhang tussen verschillende disciplines, denk je mee over conceptuele keuzes en neem je verantwoordelijkheid voor de technische kwaliteit van het elektrotechnisch ontwerp.

Je bent daarnaast een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt binnen projecten. Je adviseert opdrachtgevers en projectteams, begeleidt minder ervaren engineers en draagt actief bij aan het delen en verder ontwikkelen van kennis binnen Deerns.

 

Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren: 

  • Je ontwikkelt zelfstandig elektrotechnische concepten en ontwerpen voor complexe gebouwen.

  • Je ontwerpt installaties op het gebied van onder andere energievoorziening, verlichting, sterk- en zwakstroom, data, communicatie en beveiliging.

  • Je maakt complexe technische berekeningen en beoordeelt berekeningen en ontwerpen van collega-engineers.

  • Je voert zelfstandig technisch overleg met opdrachtgevers, architecten, uitvoerende partijen en andere betrokken stakeholders.

  • Je bewaakt de kwaliteit en voortgang van jouw werkzaamheden en signaleert tijdig afwijkingen in planning, kwaliteit of budget.

  • Je stelt technische rapportages, bestekken en andere ontwerpdocumenten op en controleert deze.

  • Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren engineers binnen projecten en helpt hen zich inhoudelijk verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Je signaleert kansen binnen projecten, denkt mee over aanvullende dienstverlening en levert waar nodig een bijdrage aan offertes en klantgesprekken.

  • Je volgt ontwikkelingen en innovaties binnen het vakgebied en deelt jouw kennis actief met collega’s.

 

Het team 

Je komt te werken in een hecht team van jong tot oud. Dit team is onderdeel van de Unit Real Estate, die in totaal uit circa 40 collega’s bestaat.Samen werken we aan nieuwbouw-, renovatie- en transformatievraagstukken voor overheden, bedrijven en instellingen van uiteenlopende schaalgrootte. Geen project is hetzelfde. Daarbij werken we veel samen met andere disciplines en expertisegroepen binnen Deerns, zowel in Nederland als daarbuiten.
