jobs.title: Senior Business Consultant
jobs.description:
Over Ockto

Ockto is een Nederlandse SaaS-scale-up die organisaties helpt om complexe financiële en administratieve processen slimmer, sneller en volledig digitaal te maken. Met ons platform kunnen consumenten veilig en eenvoudig hun persoonlijke en financiële gegevens delen, rechtstreeks vanuit betrouwbare bronnen.

Maar Ockto gaat verder dan alleen het verzamelen en delen van gegevens. We combineren, structureren, valideren en verrijken data tot complete, betrouwbare en direct bruikbare datasets. Hiermee helpen we organisaties om processen verder te automatiseren, betere beslissingen te nemen en aanvragen zoveel mogelijk volledig automatisch af te handelen (Straight Through Processing).

Onze technologie wordt ingezet door een groot aantal gerenommeerde partijen binnen Nederland, waaronder banken, leasemaatschappijen, hypotheekverstrekkers, online webshops, en overheidsinstellingen. Zo verminderen we handmatige werkzaamheden, versnellen we doorlooptijden en verbeteren we de klantbeleving, met privacy, veiligheid en compliance als belangrijke uitgangspunten.

Met meer dan 100 aangesloten organisaties bouwen we dagelijks verder aan een toekomst waarin betrouwbare data de basis vormt voor slimme, efficiënte en volledig digitale dienstverlening.

De rol

We zijn op zoek naar een Senior Business Consultant die organisaties helpt complexe business vraagstukken te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en nieuwe zakelijke kansen.

In deze rol combineer je strategisch inzicht met een commerciële blik. Je verdiept je in de behoeften, processen en uitdagingen van klanten en onderzoekt hoe Ockto's technologie hierop kan aansluiten. Daarbij kijk je verder dan de directe vraag van een klant: je begrijpt de achterliggende behoeften en weet deze te vertalen naar mogelijkheden die zowel voor de klant als voor Ockto waarde toevoegen.

Je bent een volwaardige gesprekspartner voor verschillende stakeholders en weet complexe onderwerpen helder te maken. Je bouwt relaties op, signaleert kansen en draagt bij aan de verdere groei van Ockto. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's uit onder andere sales, marketing, account management en consulting. 

Wat ga je doen?

  • Analyseren van bedrijfsprocessen, klantbehoeften en complexe business vraagstukken om kansen voor Ockto's oplossingen te identificeren.

  • Adviseren van klanten over de mogelijkheden van het platform en de waarde die digitalisering en datagedreven processen kunnen opleveren.

  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties met stakeholders en besluitvormers bij potentiële en bestaande klanten.

  • Vertalen van klantbehoeften naar concrete business cases en passende oplossingen.

  • Signaleren en ontwikkelen van nieuwe zakelijke kansen en bijdragen aan de commerciële groei van Ockto.

  • Begeleiden van gesprekken en trajecten met klanten, van de eerste behoefteanalyse tot het verder ontwikkelen van een mogelijke samenwerking.

  • Samenwerken met interne teams om klantvraagstukken te vertalen naar haalbare oplossingen en commerciële resultaten.

  • Meedenken over marktontwikkelingen, klantbehoeften en mogelijkheden om Ockto's positie in de markt verder te versterken. 

  • Meedenken over marktontwikkelingen, klantbehoeften en commerciële kansen om Ockto’s positie in de markt verder te versterken, waarbij je actief bijdraagt aan het benutten van sales mogelijkheden en het uitbouwen van klantrelaties.


Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren professional die analytisch en strategisch kan denken, maar ook begrijpt hoe je zakelijke kansen realiseert. Je weet de juiste vragen te stellen, kunt snel tot de kern van een vraagstuk komen en voelt je comfortabel in gesprekken met uiteenlopende stakeholders.

Je combineert sterke consultancy vaardigheden met commercieel inzicht. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe organisaties werken, begrijpt complexe processen en weet deze te vertalen naar concrete mogelijkheden. Daarbij neem je initiatief, bouw je gemakkelijk relaties op en verlies je de praktische en commerciële doelstellingen niet uit het oog.

Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

  • Meerdere jaren ervaring in business consulting, consultative sales of een vergelijkbare functie.

  • Ervaring met het adviseren van zakelijke klanten en het analyseren van complexe business vraagstukken.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met stakeholdermanagement op verschillende niveaus.

  • Het vermogen om klantbehoeften te vertalen naar concrete oplossingen en zakelijke kansen.

  • Een combinatie van analytisch vermogen, strategisch inzicht en commerciële slagkracht.

  • Een proactieve en zelfstandige werkhouding, met oog voor resultaat en samenwerking.

  • Affiniteit met SaaS, fintech, data oplossingen of digitale dienstverlening is een pré.

Wat biedt Ockto?

  • De mogelijkheid om bij te dragen aan de verdere groei van een Nederlandse SaaS scaleup met een bewezen platform en een groeiend klantenbestand.

  • Een inhoudelijk uitdagende functie waarin strategisch advies, klantrelaties en business development samenkomen.

  • Veel ruimte om zelfstandig te werken, kansen te signaleren en mee te denken over de ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

  • Samenwerking met collega's uit verschillende disciplines, waaronder sales, marketing, account management en consulting.

  • De kans om te werken aan technologie die complexe klantprocessen eenvoudiger, efficiënter en betrouwbaarder maakt.

  • Een salaris tussen de 4250 - 5.250 bruto per maand en arbeidsvoorwaarden passend bij jouw ervaring.

Interesse?

Wil jij jouw ervaring met business vraagstukken en klantadvies inzetten om organisaties verder te helpen én bij te dragen aan de groei van Ockto? Dan komen we graag met je in contact!

jobs.title: Kodushooldaja
jobs.description:
Koduhooldustöötaja

Tööülesanded: Aita inimestel elada väärikalt oma kodus!Estkeer otsib oma Tallinna meeskonda hoolivat, usaldusväärset ja vastutustundlikku koduhooldustöötajat. Meie töö eesmärk on toetada eakaid ja abivajavaid inimesi nende igapäevastes tegevustes, et nad saaksid võimalikult kaua, turvaliselt ja väärikalt oma kodus elada. Ootame oma meeskonda inimest, kellele läheb korda teiste heaolu ning kes soovib teha tähendusrikast ja vaheldusrikast tööd. Koduhooldustöötajana abistad kliente nende kodus vastavalt individuaalsele abivajadusele ja kokkulepitud hooldusplaanile. Sinu peamised tööülesanded on: *Abistamine igapäevastes hügieenitoimingutes (pesemine, riietumine, tualetitoimingud, mähkmete vahetamine). *Toidu valmistamine, serveerimine ja vajadusel abistamine söömisel. *Kliendi liikumise ja igapäevase aktiivsuse toetamine, abistamine liikumisel ning jalutuskäikudel. *Kergemad kodused majapidamistööd (koristamine, nõude pesemine, pesu- ja voodipesu vahetamine). *Toiduainete ja muude esmatarbekaupade ostmine. *Kliendi saatmine arsti vastuvõtule ja teistele vajalikele käikudele. *Vestlemine ja kliendi sotsiaalse aktiivsuse toetamine. *Tehtud hooldustoimingute dokumenteerimine. Töö toimub klientide kodudes. Tööpäeva jooksul külastatakse vastavalt graafikule ühte või mitut klienti. Külastuste kestus sõltub kliendi abivajadusest. Töö hõlmab hommikusi, päevaseid ja õhtuseid hoolduskülastusi ning vajalik on valmisolek töötada ka öistes vahetustes kliendi kodus.

Omalt poolt pakume: *Tähendusrikast tööd, kus Sinu panus mõjutab otseselt inimeste igapäevast heaolu.*Toetavat ja kokkuhoidvat meeskonda. *Sisseelamisprogrammi, kohapealset juhendamist ja regulaarseid sisekoolitusi. *Paindlikku töögraafikut ning võimalust töötada täis- või osalise tööajaga. *Mitmekesist ja iseseisvat tööd. *Tööks vajalikke vahendeid ja tööriietust. *Võimalust kasutada tööülesannete täitmiseks ametiautot või kokkuleppel isiklikku autot koos sõidukulude hüvitamisega. *Võimalust areneda ja täiendada oma oskusi hooldusvaldkonnas.

Muud nõuded: Nõudmised kandidaadile:*Vähemalt kutseharidus keskhariduse baasil. *Eesti keele oskus vähemalt B2-tasemel. *B-kategooria juhiluba. *Arvutikasutamise baasoskused ja valmisolek kasutada digitaalset hooldustöö dokumenteerimise süsteemi. *Valmisolek töötada graafiku alusel, sealhulgas õhtuti, nädalavahetustel ja vajadusel öösiti kliendi kodus. *Füüsiline ja vaimne valmisolek hooldustööks. OOTAME ESTKEERIGA LIITUMA KUI... *Oled empaatiline, hooliv ja sõbralik. *Oled kohusetundlik, aus ja usaldusväärne. *Suudad töötada nii iseseisvalt kui ka meeskonnas. *Oskad säilitada rahu ja leida lahendusi ka keerulisemates olukordades. *Oled tähelepanelik ning märkad muutusi kliendi enesetundes ja abivajaduses. *Austad kliendi privaatsust, väärikust ja iseseisvust. *Oled paindlik, hea suhtleja ja valmis õppima. *Sul on siiras soov aidata inimesi ja panustada nende elukvaliteedi parandamisse. Kasuks tuleb varasem hooldustöö kogemus või sotsiaal- ja tervishoiuvaldkonna haridus, kuid ootame kandideerima ka inimesi, kellel on sobivad isikuomadused ja soov valdkonnas töötada.

jobs.description:
We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

 

Your role

Help people feel at home, beyond the booking.

Booking a place is only the beginning. Moving to a new country means navigating unfamiliar processes, managing payments, and building a relationship with a landlord—all while settling into a new life. At HousingAnywhere, we want people to feel supported throughout their stay, with the confidence that comes from knowing what happens next and where to turn when they need help.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the Post Booking experience, with a strong focus on our mobile app. You will shape how tenants and landlords use HousingAnywhere throughout a tenancy: from preparing for move-in and managing payments to getting support and extending a stay.

You'll bring strong mobile app design experience and product thinking to make these everyday interactions feel simple, intuitive, and reliable—helping turn HousingAnywhere into a trusted companion throughout the rental journey.

  • Shape the long-term vision for the journey beyond the booking, making HousingAnywhere a trusted part of everyday renting.
  • Design experiences that help tenants and landlords prepare for move-in, manage payments, communicate clearly, and navigate issues with confidence.
  • Explore how we can provide ongoing value throughout a tenancy, including renewals and longer stays.
  • Lead projects from early discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Use qualitative research, behavioural data, and experimentation to make decisions, not opinions.
  • Define success, measure impact, and continuously improve your solutions—connecting customer trust and satisfaction with adoption, retention, and business value.
  • Raise the quality bar across the design team through thoughtful critique and craft.
  • Contribute to our design principles, design system, and the way we build the product.

 

Your team

Collaborate deeply. Design with absolute purpose.

You'll work alongside Product, Engineering, Research, and Data as an equal partner to challenge assumptions, validate ideas, and turn ambiguity into a product that genuinely improves people's lives. You'll also collaborate closely with our operational teams to understand where the digital experience meets the realities of moving in and renting a home.

We move fast, we think ahead, and we focus on what our audience truly needs. You'll have the freedom to influence your team's strategy in an environment that values:

  • Elegant interaction design and meaningful micro-interactions
  • Clear design principles and consistent systems
  • Accessible experiences
  • Quality over shortcuts

Shipping fast matters. Shipping something we're proud of matters even more. If you thrive on autonomy and solving complex puzzles, we want to hear from you.

 

Your profile

  • At least 7+ years of experience designing complex digital products.
  • Proven experience designing native mobile apps for iOS and Android.
  • Strong product thinking and problem framing skills.
  • Excellent interaction and visual design craft.
  • Experience in marketplaces, search or discovery products.
  • Experience running discovery and validating ideas.
  • Confidence working with data, metrics and experiments.
  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers and product managers.
  • A portfolio showing not only what you designed – but why.

 

What's in it for you

  • Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!
  • Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).
  • Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!
  • 1,000 EUR personal development budget.
  • Complete coverage for commuting.
  • Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup.
  • Gym membership discount with GoVital or OneFit.
  • Dutch/English classes budget.
  • Variable pension scheme.
  • Diverse international community (46+ nationalities).
  • Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre. 
  • Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.

jobs.title: R&D Facility & Safety Specialist
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

As an R&D Facility & Safety Specialist, you will work with the Engineering Program, Safety and Operations teams to ensure the smooth and safe operation of Proxima’s Swiss industrial facilities. This is a high-ownership role requiring strong organizational and communication skills supporting structured technical thinking.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Act as the Sicherheitsbeauftragte/r (SiBe) or Safety Contact Person for Proxima Fusion’s Swiss subsidiary.

    • Coordinate our safety organisation and keep its documentation up to date

    • Coordinate risk assessments with team leads and external safety specialists

    • Investigate incidents and near misses, and advise management on risks and corrective actions

    • Own emergency and evacuation planning, first-aider coverage and drills

    • Manage safety inductions, safety training, and access rights to facilities

    • Act as the point of contact for regulators and authorities

  • Organise the day-to-day running of our two Swiss R&D facilities: workspace layout and housekeeping, shared areas and equipment booking, storage, waste disposal, and the interface with building owners and neighbors

  • Own maintenance and operations of our tooling, equipment and technical infrastructure: preventive maintenance, repairs, calibration, and inspections

  • Manage and procure consumables and stock materials for manufacturing

WHO YOU ARE

  • An experienced technician, technical engineer, safety engineer, or operations specialist with experience in hardware development environments

  • At least 3 years of work experience in either a research institute or an industrial setting

  • Holding SiBe/KOPAS training (SUVA or equivalent), or willing to complete it in your first three months; experienced applying health and safety practice in Switzerland or the EU

  • A proactive, detail-oriented team player who takes full ownership of delivering results.

  • A confident, self-aware communicator who collaborates well and can negotiate effectively with suppliers and external partners.

  • Fluent in German and conversational in English.

  • Holding a driving license valid in Switzerland.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Training or qualifications in industrial safety

  • Experience in warehouse management - knowledge of incoming goods best practices and experience building an in-house process.

  • Knowledge of fire safety and industrial hazards

  • Experience with cryogenic, pressure equipment, chemical and electrical hazards

  • Experience with heavy lift equipment and operations

  • First aid training

  • Qualified in Switzerland to operate overhead cranes or forklifts

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • On-site Technical Panel (3x60 min)

.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

jobs.description:
Starting position designed to grow fast in a Mental Health Startup | Psychology background | French & English must | Join a mission driven Team | Passion needed | 100% | Office in the heart of Zurich with potential day trips to Romandie, remote only not possible

Why we do what we do

We see the world through the lens of our psyche — like looking through a window that casts the outside world in shades of gray or vibrant colors. Every day, each of us has the power to shift our perspective and experience reality in a new way. When people gain access to this insight, mental barriers transform into opportunities for personal growth, leading to a more fulfilling and happy life. And because happiness is contagious, society changes—one mind at a time.

You studied psychology. Now what?

You love psychology. You've spent years learning how people think, feel and change. But you don't see yourself in a therapy room every day, and the other doors everyone points you to don't feel quite right either.

There is another one. At Aepsy, you'll work with psychologists instead of patients: finding them, supporting them, growing a community together and helping them build a practice they love. Your psychology background isn't a nice-to-have here. It's the reason psychologists will trust you.

The role

As Community Manager Romandie, you own our community of French-speaking psychologists in Switzerland, as part of our Community & Operations team in Zurich alongside the leads for our German-, Italian- and English-speaking communities. You find and onboard psychologists, you are their first point of contact, help them with administrative and everyday questions, and look out for new opportunities so they can bloom. Together, we will shape the role around your strengths and passions. This is a starting position designed to grow fast, with real ownership from your first weeks.

Be their voice inside Aepsy

  • Bring psychologists' feedback into our product, processes and operations

  • Work closely with our marketing, product & design, sales and insurance partnerships teams

  • Help with client support, translations and content in French

  • Spot what's not working yet and come up with better ways to do it

Key things we are looking for

  • You enjoy reaching out to people, finding out authentically what the right path is for them. When something gets in their way, you don't just take it away, you want to make it better. This role needs both: the courage to reach out and the heart to take care.

  • You're structured and at the same time full of ideas you want to push for. You're proactive, see opportunities in challenges, and thrive in a team where everyone supports each other and grows for something bigger.

  • If you hear about Aepsy's mission, your heart should beat faster, and your hand should instinctively reach out — because you won't want to miss the opportunity to be part of it. We need people who are crazy enough to believe that their actions can change the world.

In a nutshell

  • Full-time position (100%) on-site in Zurich, with potential day trips to Romandie

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Psychology

  • Work experience or projects that demonstrates your dedication (customer-facing, sales, student association…)

  • Structured, proactive and independent, and a natural relationship builder

  • Native or bilingual proficiency in French (spoken & written)

  • Good English (spoken & written) to work and communicate with our team every day

Together with us

We are a vibrant team with diverse backgrounds and beliefs, and we genuinely love what we do. We love conversations about the big picture as much as the smallest details. We work hard to make the world a slightly better place.

At the same time, we are mothers, fathers, husbands and wives, wine lovers, stand-up comedians, musicians, dancers, yoga practitioners, and Zen monks who appreciate and enjoy life.

Ready to join?

Sleep on it, take another look at this job ad. Read it again, believe that you belong at Aepsy, take a deep breath, and send us a personal application letter. (Yes, we will read it carefully, so please don’t send us generic templates, ChatGPT building blocks, or anything similar—there are so many better things to do.) Include your resume, and we look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Data Platform Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

As Data Platform Manager you will own Destinus's company data platform. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week.

You will own its architecture: how OneLake and our lakehouses are structured, how data lands in them from the systems we run, and how it holds up as more of the business comes to depend on it. You will lead a small team of data engineers — setting direction, reviewing their work, growing them — and you will keep building yourself. You are also the person who makes our AI ambitions possible: the foundation behind our data agents and our Company Brain is yours to design and deliver.

At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive.

What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people.
  • Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do.
  • Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source.
  • Own the gold layer and the semantic models built on it, so that Power BI reads from one governed source rather than from copies scattered around the business.
  • Work closely with our Business Operations & Data Specialists, who represent the business owners of each domain: turn their requirements into the right gold tables, agree definitions with them, and give them a platform they can query, validate, and explain to the business with confidence.
  • Own lineage across the estate: know what feeds what, be able to prove it to an auditor, and make dependencies visible rather than tribal knowledge.
  • Build the data foundation for our AI programme — the lakehouse structures, pipelines, and knowledge graph behind our Fabric data agents and our Company Brain — and deliver it to a standard that can be trusted with a real question.
  • Design and maintain the OneLake security and access model together with your team: workspace roles, access groups, and the controls that decide who sees what in the lake.
  • Keep the platform reliable, observable, and cost-aware: monitoring, alerting, recovery, and disciplined use of our Fabric capacity — including knowing what a runaway notebook costs us.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5-8 years of data engineering experience, including real ownership of a lakehouse architecture rather than only delivering against someone else's.
  • Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience is strongly preferred — OneLake, lakehouses, Delta tables, the SQL analytics endpoint, Data Factory pipelines, Spark notebooks, and semantic models in Direct Lake mode. If your depth is in Azure Synapse, Databricks, or Data Lake Storage Gen2 and you have since moved onto Fabric in earnest, we will take that seriously.
  • Strong command of the medallion pattern and of Delta Lake in practice: partitioning, schema evolution, table maintenance, and why a gold table behaves the way it does.
  • Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQL, solid PySpark, and comfort building and orchestrating pipelines yourself. This is not a role that stops at diagrams.
  • Practical understanding of Fabric capacity: how workloads consume it, how to spot what is burning it, and how to keep the platform inside its envelope.
  • Experience leading engineers — formally, or as a technical lead who set direction and mentored others. A first step into people management is welcome if the technical leadership is already there.
  • Proven integration experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 / MSD, as well as APIs, flat-file landings, and change data capture from operational databases.
  • Solid data modelling skills, including dimensional modelling and an understanding of how a semantic layer serves Power BI.
  • Working knowledge of lineage, data governance, and access control in a cloud platform; exposure to Microsoft Purview is a plus.
  • Interest or experience in the data foundations behind AI assistants — retrieval, knowledge graphs, and preparing data so that an agent can answer with it.
  • Aerospace or another regulated industry is an advantage; so is experience in a start-up or scale-up.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

Who You Are

You are an architect who never stops building. You have strong opinions about how a platform should be structured, and you earn the right to them by being in the code. You would rather make a design decision explicit and documented than let it live in one person's head.

You care more about reliability than novelty. You know that the measure of a data platform is whether people trust the numbers that come out of it on a Monday morning, not how modern the stack looks on a slide. When something breaks, you want to know why it was possible, not just how to patch it.

You enjoy growing engineers, and you understand that leading a small team means doing the work alongside them. Above all, you want to build something durable — a foundation that holds while the company scales on top of it.

jobs.title: Business Operations & Data Specialist (Production & Quality)

About the role

Behind every well-run plant is a shared understanding of how it is performing — and that understanding has to be built. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Production & Quality at Destinus, you are the bridge between the people who run our plants and the data that describes them. Plant managers, production leads, and quality engineers own the processes; our lakehouse holds the data those processes create. Your job is to connect the two, so that every production and quality figure, from the shopfloor to the leadership team, is defined by the business, built on the lakehouse, and trusted by both.

This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what the business needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the production and quality data in the lakehouse and turning it into the reporting used across three European plants, including our Digital Shopfloor Management Solution, relied on by more than 300 people. You will also go to where the data is created and make it better there — improving how it is captured, automating what is still manual, and helping three plants work to one standard.

At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our operations span multiple plants and teams, and your work will directly support the reliability, efficiency, and excellence required for mission-critical production. Join us in shaping the next era of aerospace operations.

What You'll do

  • Be the go-to contact between the business owners of production and quality data — plant managers, production leads, and quality engineers — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on.
  • Own the production and quality portfolio end to end: define the KPI, improve the process behind it, build the dashboard, and stand behind the number.
  • Own the production and quality domain in our lakehouse: know which tables and fields hold what, where each comes from, and who owns it at source — and keep that knowledge documented rather than in your head.
  • Partner with our Data Engineers on the curated (gold) layer for production and quality: specify the tables, fields, and business rules the business needs, and validate the result against what actually happens on the shopfloor before anyone relies on it.
  • Set and monitor data quality checks for your domain, and route each issue to the right owner — the person entering the data, the system configuration, or the pipeline — until it is fixed.
  • Maintain and continuously improve Power BI dashboards tracking production and quality performance across all three plants, built on certified lakehouse data rather than side spreadsheets.
  • Describe production and quality data in plain business language — what each field means, who owns it, and how sensitive it is — for our shared meanings layer, so that colleagues and our AI assistants can use it correctly without having to ask you first.
  • Automate what is manual today: recurring reports, data collection, and the preparation behind daily and weekly performance routines.
  • Support the standardisation of ways of working across the three plants, partnering with our Lean Operations Specialist so that measurement and improvement pull in the same direction.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

  • Experience in a production or quality environment; aerospace or another regulated industry is highly preferred.

jobs.title: Research Engineer Privacy and Anonymization
jobs.description:
Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones)
Start Date: ASAP
Languages: English
Team: Engineering

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.

This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

  • Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

  • Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

  • Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

  • Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

  • Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

  • Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

  • Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

  • Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

  • An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

  • High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

  • Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

  • Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

  • Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

  • Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

  • Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

  • From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

  • Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

  • San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

jobs.description: About the roleOur end customer is an international medical technology company developing devices and solutions used in healthcare environments. findings clearly.- Good English communication skills, both written and spoken.- The ability and willingness to work on-site at the testing laboratory in Vallila, Helsinki, on a daily basis.A You can learn the product-specific verification methods and procedures on the job.To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:- Systematic and detail-oriented: You work carefully, follow test procedures, and understand the importance of accurate documentation.- Responsible and reliable: You take ownership of your work and ensure that findings are reported clearly and accurately.- Collaborative and service-minded: You enjoy supporting engineers and working with different stakeholders.- Communicative and proactive: You are comfortable asking questions, discussing technical requirements, and raising potential issues.- Resilient and adaptable: You can manage changing priorities and requests from multiple projects.Other information- Location and remote work: The position is based in Vallila, Helsinki. Because the work involves physical devices and laboratory equipment, daily on-site presence is expected. Occasional remote work may be possible for tasks such as finalizing reports.- Contract duration: The position is full-time and fixed-term until the end of 2027. jobs.title: People Partner to KUKA Group
jobs.description: Are you an experienced HR professional who enjoys working closely with managers and employees? Do you thrive in a hands-on role where you can combine you HR expertise with a proactive and service-minded approach?We are now looking for a Senior People Partner to join Visual Components and KUKA Group in Finland. Here, you will take on a broad and varied HR role with the opportunity to contribute to developing processes and ways of working within an international organisation.Sounds interesting? We look forward to receiving your application! ABOUT THE ROLE As Senior People Partner, you will support managers and employees across Visual Components and other KUKA businesses in Finland. You will act as a trusted point of contact for everyday HR matters, providing guidance and ensuring effective HR processes throughout the employee lifecycle.The role is part of the Nordic People & Organisation (P&O) function and you will work closely with local managers, Nordic P&O colleagues and the Shared Service Centre in Hungary, contributing to consistent HR processes and ways of working.Your main responsibilities will include:• Provide day-to-day HR support and guidance to managers and employees. • Manage employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, internal movements, leave and offboarding. • Advise on HR policies, procedures and employee relations matters. • Coordinate local HR processes and ensure accurate employee records. • Support performance reviews, development initiatives and organisational changes.The position is based at Visual Components’ office in Espoo, Finland, and you report to the Head of P&O Nordic in Sweden. ABOUT YOU We are looking for an experienced HR professional with a broad operational background who enjoys working hands-on and building strong relationships across the organisation. You are confident in your HR expertise, comfortable working independently and thrive in a changing international environment.We believe you have:• At least 10 years of experience in operational HR. • Broad knowledge of HR processes, employee relations and local employment practices. • Experience advising managers on a variety of HR matters. • A relevant university degree, preferably within HR. • Fluency in Finnish and English.Experience from an international matrix organisation, a technology or engineering environment, or SAP SuccessFactors is considered an advantage. Swedish language skills are also a plus.As a person, you are proactive, structured and approachable. You communicate clearly, take initiative and enjoy finding practical solutions. You are comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues in a changing environment. CONTACT Does this opportunity sound interesting and align with your experience and ambitions? In this recruitment process, Visual Components and KUKA Group is partnering with Committo. For more information, please contact Linda Samuelsson at linda.samuelsson@committo.se or +46 702 16 37 52 or Sofia Erikson at sofia.erikson@committo.se or +46 73-642 75 69.Interviews and selection are conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you! ABOUT THE COMPANY KUKA is a global automation corporation with sales of around 4 billion euro and approximately 15,000 employees. The company is headquartered in Augsburg, Germany. As one of the world’s leading suppliers of intelligent automation solutions, KUKA offers customers everything they need from a single source: from robots and cells to fully automated systems and their networking in markets such as automotive, electronics, metal & plastic, consumer goods, e-commerce/retail and healthcare.Visual Components is a leading developer of 3D manufacturing simulation software and solutions. Founded in 1999 by a team of simulation experts, we started with a humble goal – to make manufacturing design and simulation technology easy to use and accessible to manufacturing organizations of all sizes. Since 2017 Visual Components has been a part of KUKA Group.

jobs.title: IT Manager
jobs.description: We are looking for an **IT Manager** to join our team at Phillips Medisize in Kontiolahti.In this key site role, you will be responsible for ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient IT services and infrastructure supporting our manufacturing operations. You will act as the primary interface between site operation and business functions, global IT organizations, and external technology partners.**What you will do**As IT Manager, you will have a broad and hands-on role in developing and supporting our local IT environment. Your key responsibilities include:- Maintaining and continuously developing the site's IT infrastructure to ensure secure, reliable, and efficient operations - Coordinating IT infrastructure upgrades, system improvements, and technology deployments - Providing local IT support and coordinating troubleshooting with global support teams and external service providers - Acting as the key link between site functions, global IT organizations, and technology vendors - Supporting the implementation of global IT initiatives, standards, and systems at site level - Supporting business continuity, including legacy applications where migration to global solutions is not feasible - Participating in IT budget planning and providing recommendations on technology investments and infrastructure development - Ensuring compliance with corporate IT policies, information security requirements, and applicable standards - Driving continuous improvement of IT services, systems, and business processes. **What we are looking for**You combine solid IT expertise with a strong understanding of business needs. You enjoy working close to operations and are comfortable collaborating with both local stakeholders and global IT teams.We expect you to have:- Bachelor's or Master's degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, business information systems, or another relevant field. An equivalent combination of education and professional experience may also be considered. - Experience in IT infrastructure support, IT service management, business applications, or a business-facing IT role - Good understanding of IT infrastructure, end-user computing, enterprise applications, and network environments - Understanding of information security principles and corporate IT governance - Experience working with global IT organizations and external vendors - Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills - A customer-oriented and service-minded approach - Ability to manage multiple priorities - Excellent communications skills in both Finnish and English Experience from a manufacturing environment and participation in IT projects are considered an advantage.**Why this role matters**This is an opportunity to work close to the heart of our manufacturing operations and have a tangible impact on how technology supports the site. You will combine hands-on local IT responsibility with global collaboration, helping ensure business continuity today while developing smarter, more efficient, and secure solutions for the future.You will work closely with site management, business functions, operation teams, global IT teams, end users, and external technology partners.

jobs.title: Markkinointi- ja viestintäasiantuntija
jobs.description: Primary location:TUUSULAHaemme markkinointi- ja viestintäasiantuntijaa Meira Novan markkinointi- ja viestintätiimiin. Tässä roolissa vastaat monipuolisesti yrityksemme markkinoinnin ja viestinnän suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta.Keskeisiä tehtäviäsi ovat markkinointi- ja myyntimateriaalien suunnittelu, tuottaminen ja jalkauttaminen monikanavaisesti, valikoimajaksojen ja sesonkien tuotetietojen koordinointi, verkkosivuston sisältöjen kehittäminen, asiakastapahtumien ja messujen koordinointi sekä sisäinen viestintä. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä myynnin ja hankinnan sekä mainostoimistokumppaneiden ja toimittajien kanssa ja osallistut markkinoinnin ja viestinnän kehityshankkeisiin. Yhdistät työssäsi kaupallisen ajattelun, luovuuden ja vahvan toteutuskyvyn ja tuet kaupallisen tiimin menestystä ajan hermolla olevalla tuoteviestinnällä.Mitä odotamme sinulta?Sinulla on kokemusta markkinoinnin ja viestinnän laaja-alaisista tehtävistä sekä aktiivinen, asiakaslähtöinen ja oma-aloitteinen työote. Olet järjestelmällinen ja huolellinen, toimit hyvin paineen alla ja työskentelet luontevasti sekä tiimissä että itsenäisesti. Sinulla on hyvä visuaalinen silmä, erinomaiset yhteistyö- ja viestintätaidot sekä kiinnostusta foodservice-toimialaan. Soveltuva kaupallisen alan tai markkinoinnin ja viestinnän korkeakoulututkinto antaa hyvän pohjan tehtävään. Hyödynnät tekoälyä arjessasi ja viestit sujuvasti suomeksi ja englanniksi. Hallitset Adobe InDesignin ja Photoshopin, ja sinulla on kokemusta HubSpotista sekä projektinhallinnasta.Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen elintarvikealalta tai mainostoimistosta sekä tuotetietojen hallinnasta esimerkiksi GS1 Synkka- tai Akeneo PIM -järjestelmissä. Lisäksi arvostamme valokuvausosaamista sekä Contentfulin ja Canvan tuntemusta.Tule voittavaan joukkueeseenMeira Novan kaupallisessa organisaatiossa, jonka osana markkinointi- ja viestintätiimi toimii, työskentelee noin 50 henkilöä. Tässä joukkueessa taidamme itsenäisen työskentelyn, mutta nautimme siitä, että saamme tehdä toistemme kanssa töitä. Tehtävän huolellinen ja tehokas hoitaminen tuottaa korkeaa asiakastyytyväisyyttä sekä yritysmielikuvamme vahvistumista ja varmistaa osaltaan yksikön tavoitteiden saavuttamista.Työtyytyväisyys on meille tärkeää, ja siksi varmistamme, että työntekijät pääsevät mukaan muutosten suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen. Uskomme, että osallistaminen lisää sitoutumista ja tekee kehityksestä sujuvampaa – yhdessä rakennamme toimivampia ratkaisuja ja parempaa työarkea. Meillä on S-ryhmän monipuoliset henkilöstöedut: https://s-ryhma.fi/tyopaikat/erinomaiset-edutMiltä tämä kaikki vaikutti? Oletko kiinnostunut tästä tehtävästä?Hae tehtävää hakulinkin kautta viimeistään 29.11.2026. Käymme hakemuksia läpi ja haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana, joten älä odota viime hetkeen.Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa markkinointipäällikkö Laura Matilainen puh. 010 76 86508. Varmimmin saat Lauran kiinnipe 13.11.2026 klo 14–15 tai pe 20.11.2026 klo 14–15.Osana S-ryhmää toimiva, vuonna 1991 perustettu Meira Nova on Suomen johtavia foodservice-alan tukkukauppoja. Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme luotettavan kumppanuuden, johon on turvallista nojata nyt ja tulevaisuudessa. Palvelemme 250 ammattilaisen voimin ravintoloita, hotelleja, liikenneasemia sekä terveys- ja hoivapalvelusektorin sekä julkishallinnon toimijoita. Logistiikkakeskuksemme sijaitsee Tuusulassa.

jobs.title: Venue Operations and Client Support Co-Ordinator
jobs.description: Venue Operations and Client Support Co-OrdinatorAgTechUCD Innovation Centre, UCD Lyons FarmPosition type    Full-time Fixed Term for 24 monthsLocation    AgTechUCD Innovation Centre, UCD Lyons Research Farm, Celbridge, Co KildareReports to    Director of Innovation UCDSalary    €60,000 per year Hours    37 hours Full-time, with occasional evening and weekend eventsAbout AgTechUCDAgTechUCD is University College Dublin’s innovation centre for early-stage start-ups and SMEs working in agri, agtech, agrifood and veterinary sectors. Part of NovaUCD, it builds on NovaUCD’s track record of supporting high-tech start-ups. It is a collaboration between UCD and a network of industry, investor and research partners.AgTechUCD is a collaboration between NovaUCD, Kildare County Council, and Kildare LEO and is funded by the Regional Enterprise Development Fund. It also includes support from agri-companies such as; Devenish, Dairymaster, and Glanbia; investors such as; The Yield Lab, and Atlantic Bridge, along with leading AgTech researchers and innovators at UCD, Teagasc and Wageningen University and Research, Netherlands.  The AgTech Innovation Centre is based at UCD Lyons Farm, the University’s research and teaching farm. The building (about 890 sq.m.) offers flexible lab spaces, meeting rooms, offices and an exhibition space, and sits alongside the UCD Bimeda Herd Health Hub. It is home to a growing community of resident companies and is also available as a venue for events, workshops and industry gatherings.The RoleWe are looking for an energetic, organised and practical Venue Operations and Client Support Co-Ordinator to run the building day to day and to grow its profile as a venue for events and home for AgTech Start Up companies.This is primarily an operations role, with a meaningful commercial side. You will spend roughly 60% of your time on operations (building, events delivery and resident support and financial management and reporting) and 40% on marketing and sales (promoting the venue, winning event bookings and building relationships). An important part of the role is attracting clients to take up space in the incubator be it office or lab space and also selling the exhibition area and meeting rooms as an important event space.  A key requirement of the role is to attract business to the incubator and ensure it is an attractive area for prospective clients.  You will be the first point of contact for our resident companies and for everyone who hires or visits the space.Flexibility is required in this role (in working hours and tasks) and excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as a willingness to travel as needed and a full driving licence will all be essential for this positionKey Responsibilities1. Building and Facilities Operations•    Oversee the daily running of the building, including access control, opening and closing procedures and building security.•    Act as the main point of contact for maintenance and building services and out-of-hours contacts. Manage relationships with contractors and service providers (for example HVAC, plumbing, electrical, IT and broadband), log and prioritise issues, and make sure repairs are completed promptly. Technical repairs are carried out by qualified contractors; you coordinate and follow up.•    Carry out regular building walk-throughs to keep the centre clean, organised and safe, and to meet Health and Safety requirements, including the specific requirements of a lab and farm-campus environment.•    Liaise with UCD campus services and Lyons Farm colleagues on shared infrastructure, site access and safety procedures.•    Manage inventory and ordering for kitchen supplies, office consumables and event equipment.2. Event Coordination and Delivery•    Act as the primary contact for internal and external event hosts, from first enquiry through to delivery and follow-up.•    Prepare event spaces before bookings and reset them promptly afterwards, including room layouts and equipment setup.•    Provide on-the-ground support during events, including A/V and lighting setup, layout changes and immediate troubleshooting.•    Coordinate third-party suppliers such as caterers, equipment hire companies and cleaners.•    Gather feedback after events and use it to improve the venue offering.3. Resident Company Support and Community•    Be the day-to-day go-to person for resident start-ups and SMEs, creating a welcoming, collaborative and energetic atmosphere.•    Manage onboarding and offboarding of resident companies, including induction, access, desk and lab space allocation and handover.•    Organise community activities that add value for residents, such as networking sessions, coffee mornings, skill-sharing sessions and visits from investors, industry partners and researchers.•    Work closely with the AgTechUCD and NovaUCD teams to support accelerator programme activity and events hosted in the building.4. Venue Marketing and Event Sales•    Promote the venue to corporate clients, agri-food and agtech networks, industry bodies, community groups and external event organisers, with the aim of growing event booking revenue.•    Develop and run marketing activity for the venue, including social media content, creative materials, newsletters and direct outreach.•    Conduct site tours for prospective clients, presenting the layout options, technical capability and amenities of the building.•    Create and maintain attractive event packages covering room layouts, technical setup and catering partnerships, with clear pricing.•    Manage the enquiry-to-booking process, track leads and bookings, and report regularly on occupancy and revenue.•    Build relationships with local and sector networks in the agri-food, agtech and university communities to raise the profile of the building as a destination for events.5. Financial Management/Governance and Reporting•    Report to various stakeholders both internal and external including the UCD Director of Innovation and the UCD Nova DAC board•    Process RFQs, tenders , raise requisitions and close out the purchasing process adhering to UCDs procurement process.•    Create and issue Client/Customer monthly invoices and manage and report on De Minimus passthrough.Essential Skills and Experience•    2 to 4 years’ experience in venue management, events coordination, hospitality, co-working or innovation-space operations, or a similar customer-facing role.•    Proven ability to manage a building or venue in practice: coordinating contractors, solving problems quickly and keeping standards high.•    Experience promoting a venue, service or brand through social media, networking and direct outreach, and converting enquiries into bookings.•    A friendly, confident and professional manner, with the ability to build strong relationships with start-up founders, clients and suppliers.•    Strong organisational skills and a hands-on, “no task too small” attitude. You are comfortable dealing with a facilities issue in the morning and pitching to a client in the afternoon.•    Comfort with workplace technology: A/V equipment, access control and booking systems, and social media tools, or a willingness to learn them quickly.•    A practical, hands-on approach to setting up rooms and equipment for events.•    Financial management, including budgeting, and reporting experience is required.•    Flexibility to work occasional evenings and weekends for events.•    Experience working as part of a team and ability to direct staff and contractors•    Full jobs.title: Driftsmedarbeidar bygg og eigedom
jobs.description:
Me søkjer ein praktisk og allsidig driftsmedarbeidar med erfaring frå bygg og vedlikehald. Stillinga omfattar dagleg drift, tilsyn og vedlikehald av BKE sine bygg og eigedomar, både innvendig og utvendig. Du vil arbeide tett saman med driftsansvarleg, som også vil vere din næraste overordna.

Hva vi ser etter

Me ser etter deg som har erfaring frå bygg, vedlikehald eller handverksfag, og som trivst med praktisk og variert arbeid.

Fagbrev innan byggfag, målarfaget eller anna relevant handverksfag er ein fordel, men relevant praktisk erfaring kan kompensere for manglande fagbrev. Du må ha førerkort kl. B.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Praktisk vedlikehald, mindre reparasjonar og bygningsmessige utbetringar

  • Måling, overflatebehandling og anna innvendig og utvendig vedlikehald

  • Plenklipping, stell av grøntområde og anna vedlikehald av uteareal

  • Tilsyn med bygg, eigedomar og tekniske anlegg

  • Registrering og oppfølging av feil og vedlikehaldsbehov i BKE sitt FDV system

  • Kontakt med leigetakarar, brukarar og leverandørar

  • Ved behov praktisk oppfølging av handverkarar og eksterne tenesteleverandørar

  • Bestilling av materiell og mindre arbeid innanfor avtalte rammer

  • Bidra til å ivareta den daglege drifta ved fråvær hos driftsansvarleg

Vi tilbyr

  • Ei stilling med ein variert arbeidskvardag og mange ulike oppgåver innan bygg, eigedom og vedlikehald

  • Eit godt og uformelt arbeidsmiljø med korte avgjerdsvegar og tett samarbeid

  • God opplæring og støtte frå kollegaer

  • Løn og arbeidsvilkår etter avtale

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bømlo Kommunale Eigedomsselskap AS (BKE) er eit kommunalt aksjeselskap, heileigd av Bømlo kommune. BKE eig og forvaltar 156 kommunale utleigebustader, næringseigedom og tomter, med ein samla verdi på om lag 219 mill. kroner.

Hovudoppgåva til BKE er å tilby kommunale utleigebustader, trygde- og omsorgsbustader til personar som har behov for bistand på bustadmarknaden. Utleiga skjer i samarbeid med Bømlo kommune. Selskapet kan også utvikle, drifte, vedlikehalde og forvalte andre eigedomar til kommunale føremål.

BKE er ein liten organisasjon med korte avgjerdsvegar og tett samarbeid. Me held til i Hollundsdalen på Bømlo.

jobs.title: SEASONAL RESORT SUPERVISOR - SONKA RESORT
jobs.description: **Full-time seasonal position | Winter 2026–2027 | Rovaniemi, Finnish Lapland | Immediate start****Sonka Resort is looking for a hands-on Resort Supervisor to coordinate daily operations across reception, housekeeping and maintenance during the winter season.**Part of Arctic GM Experiences Oy, Sonka is a premium lakeside retreat in Rovaniemi in Finnish Lapland, bringing together panoramic mirror houses, private villas and authentic Arctic experiences.Working on site and reporting to management, youll organise each day around arrivals, departures and guest needs. Youll give colleagues clear priorities, check that rooms and services are ready on time, and step in personally when the team needs support. We welcome applications from hospitality professionals who have helped organise a shift, guided colleagues or trained new staff and are ready to take on more responsibility.**Tasks**- Review upcoming bookings, occupancy and special requests. Prepare and adjust staff schedules, allocate tasks and make sure each shift receives a clear handover. - Work directly with reservations and booking systems. Keep room allocations, guest details and availability accurate, and flag discrepancies across booking channels. - Coordinate arrivals, departures and booked activities. Answer guest enquiries, resolve day-to-day concerns and involve management when a decision falls outside your authority. - Check accommodation and shared areas before guests arrive. Coordinate with housekeeping and maintenance, record outstanding issues and follow up until the work is complete. - Support and train colleagues in daily routines. Step in at reception or elsewhere on site when plans change or the resort gets busy. - Keep practical guest information up to date. Give management concise updates on completed work, outstanding issues and decisions needed, and suggest improvements based on what you see on site. **Requirements**- Experience in hospitality, tourism or a comparable guest-facing environment, including **administrative work** such as reservations, scheduling, record-keeping or reporting. - Experience coordinating tasks or supporting colleagues during a busy shift, with a willingness to learn and grow into the supervisory role. - A reliable, organised approach and the ability to set priorities, work independently and follow through. - A calm, guest-focused manner and fluent spoken and written English. - Availability to **start immediately and work full-time on site at Sonka Resort for the winter season**. - A **valid Category B driving licence recognised in Finland**. Having your own car for the daily commute is strongly preferred. - The existing legal right to work in Finland without employer-sponsored work authorisation. Experience with hotel reservation systems, online booking platforms or winter destinations is an advantage.**Benefits**- A seasonal supervisory role with responsibility for organising shifts and maintaining service standards at a lakeside resort in Finnish Lapland. - The opportunity to build supervisory experience across reception, housekeeping and maintenance while working closely with Arctic GM management. - The chance to put practical improvements into everyday use, from clearer shift handovers to better coordination of guest arrivals. **How to apply**Please send your **CV and a short introduction** to **lison@arcticgm.com**. jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager, MEDIT
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.
   
    


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.
   
    


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €153,000-€171,000 per year.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Facility Director
jobs.description:
About Nordscale

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centers. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data center operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

 

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

 

About the Role (Job Purpose)

As Facility Director, you will lead Nordscale’s Facility Management unit at Kvandal South outside Narvik, one of the largest AI data-centre projects in Europe. You will be central in building the  unit ahead of and during the start of operations. You will hold overall responsibility for safe and stable operation of the facility, the buildings and the services around them, around the clock.

 

You will report to the Site Director and lead managers within quality, HSE, site coordination and logistics, sustainability and technical operations. 

 

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)
  • Recruit and build the Facility Management unit, and prepare the organisation, procedures and suppliers for the start of operations in 2027.
  • Hold overall responsibility for safe, stable and efficient 24/7 operation of the facility. This includes building and site services such as property management, security, logistics, spare parts and sustainability.
  • Own the operational management system, including KPIs, meeting structure, reporting and follow-up. Build a strong safety and quality culture with strict operational discipline, and act as Incident Commander during major incidents.
  • Work closely with the Site Director, Nscale and IT teams. Manage supplier performance and budgets for maintenance, upgrades, energy and technical services. 

 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

 You may be an experienced leader from data centres. You may also come from other technically complex, continuous operations where downtime has major consequences, such as process industry, metallurgy, pulp and paper, offshore, maritime operations, power or technical defence environments. Experience from establishing an operating organisation before a facility enters regular operation is an advantage. 

You are motivated by building something from the ground up, and you combine trust with clear follow-up. You know that following the standard and improving it are equally important parts of the same responsibility.

 

Key characteristics

  •  Structured and systematic, working with strong procedural discipline and attention to detail.
  • Resilient under pressure, identifying challenges and finding pragmatic, holistic solutions.
  • Builds relationships of trust, collaboration and mutual respect, communicates clearly and listens actively.

 

Skills & Qualifications 

  •  Solid experience leading managers across several technical disciplines and support functions in 24/7 operations, together with subcontractors.
  • A strong track record in safety culture and HSE, including work and access permits, safe isolation, risk assessment and change management.
  • Experience with establishing and leading a performance management system, policies and procedures (SOPs etc) and supplier follow-up
  • Sound understanding of electrical, cooling and mechanical systems.
  • Experience from commissioning and start-up is an advantage.
  • Fluent English and a Scandinavian language, written and spoken. 
  • A master’s degree in electrical, mechanical or automation engineering is preferred. Other relevant technical education combined with documented operational experience will also be considered. 
What We Can Offer You
  • Competitive salary negotiable based on experience. 
  • Performance-based bonus tied to results and company performance. 
  • The chance to build the operating organisation, procedures and safety culture from the ground up, and to lead Kvandal South into operation in 2027.
  • Relocation support assessed individually, if required.  
Equal Opportunities Statement

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

 

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.
