jobs.title: SPECIJALIST ZA AUTOMATIKU I ELEKTRONIKU
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 28. stavka 1. Zakona o vodnim uslugama (NN 66/19) i članka 35. Društvenog ugovora Vodovoda d.o.o. Zadar a u skladu sa Smjernicama za provedbu Odluke o donošenju općih akata o postupku zapošljavanja u trgovačkim društvima u vlasništvu Grada Zadra i ustanovama kojima je osnivač, direktor Društva Ivan Bašić, dipl. ing. el. objavljuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za radno mjesto: Specijalist za automatiku i elektroniku

(broj izvršitelja 1)

Radni odnos zasniva se na neodređeno vrijeme, uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci.

Uvjeti:

Zahtijevana kvalifikacija: VŠS (viša stručna sprema) — završen preddiplomski studij, 180 do 240 ECTS bodova — elektrotehničkog smjera; Razine: 6.st., 6.sv. - Elektrotehničkog/elektroinženjerskog usmjerenja (automatika, elektronika, robotika ili srodni smjer)

Mjesto rada: Zadar

Radno vrijeme:puno radno vrijeme

Raspored radnog vremena: prijepodne

Naknada za prijevoz: u cijelosti

Smještaj: nema

Radno iskustvo: 2 godine radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima; iskustvo sa SCADA/PLC sustavima prednost

Vozačka dozvola B kategorije

Napredno korištenje računala (MS Office, AutoCAD, SCADA/PLC softveri);

Ostali zahtjevi radnog mjesta:

poznavanje engleskog jezika; komunikacijske i analitičke vještine; poznavanje SCADA sustava

Plaća: Visina plaće utvrdit će se unutar pripadajućeg platnog razreda, ovisno o stručnimkvalifikacijama, radnom iskustvu, kompetencijama i drugim objektivnim kriterijima, sukladno važećim internim aktima Društva; Kandidati će prije pristupanja razgovoru biti obaviješteni o pripadajućem platnom razredu i predviđenom rasponu bruto plaće za navedeno radno mjesto.

Opis posla:

  • Planiranje, organiziranje, provedba i nadzor radova na održavanju, servisiranju i kalibraciji automatike i elektroničke opreme na vodoopskrbnim objektima i objektima odvodnje;
  • Sudjelovanje u planiranju godišnjeg održavanja opreme za automatiku i elektroniku te izrade godišnjeg plana nabave;
  • Prema potrebi sudjelovanje u pripremi dokumentacije za provedbu nabave za potrebe Službe crpljenja vode/ Odjela održavanja CP;
  • Praćenje provedbe i nadzor nad izvršenjem ugovora;
  • Programiranje i konfiguracija PLC uređaja, frekventnih pretvarača i SCADA sustava;
  • Vođenje i nadziranje periodičnih pregleda i servisa, remonta i drugih radova na opremi za automatiku i elektroniku;
  • Praćenje i evidentiranje stanja opreme za automatiku i elektroniku te izvještavanje rukovoditelja Službe crpljenja vode;
  • Dijagnostika, otklanjanje kvarova i servisiranje SCADA/PLC sustava, relejne zaštite i upravljačkih ormara;
  • Izrada, revizija i ažuriranje tehničke dokumentacije iz područja elektroopreme i automatike;
  • Priprema objekata za pregled od strane Ex-agencije (oprema u eksplozivnoj zoni);
  • Prikupljanje i analiza podataka o radu vodospremišta i crpnih postaja putem SCADA sustava;
  • Predlaganje mjera za povećanje pouzdanosti i učinkovitosti vodospremišta i crpnih postaja;
  • Predlaganje poboljšanja u radu, rješavanje problema i iznalaženje novih tehničkih rješenja;
  • Osposobljavanje i upute za rad ostalim zaposlenicima Službe crpljenja vode/ Odjela održavanja CP s automatskom opremom;

U prijavi je potrebno navesti osobne podatke: ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona/mobitela i e-mail adresu te priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju:

  1. Životopis;
  2. Dokaz o ispunjavanju uvjeta stručne spreme – preslika diplome;
  3. Elektronički zapis o radnopravnom statusu iz evidencije Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (HZMO), ne stariji od šest mjeseci;
  4. Dokaz o posjedovanju vozačke dozvole B kategorije – preslika važeće vozačke dozvole;
  5. Dokaz o poznavanju engleskog jezika – potvrda, certifikat, vlastoručno potpisana izjava kandidata ili druga odgovarajuća isprava.

Sva tražena dokumentacija može se dostaviti u neovjerenoj preslici a dostavljena dokumentacija se ne vraća. Kandidat koji bude odabran, dužan je dostaviti na uvid dokumentaciju u izvorniku.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji ("Narodne novine" br.121/17, 198/19, 84/21 i 156/23) uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 9. Zakona o

profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom ("Narodne novine" br.157/13, 152/14,39/18 I 32/20), dužan se pozvati na čl. 9. istog Zakona te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja priložiti dokaze o priznatom statusu osobe s invaliditetom sukladno Pravilniku o sadržaju i načinu vođenja očevidnika zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48.f Zakona о zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata ("Narodne novine” 33/92, 77/92, 27/93,58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 I 98/19) dužan je priložiti, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, rješenje odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, te dokaz o tome na koji mu je način prestao radni odnos.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno odredbi članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata ("Narodne novine" 84/21) dužan se pozvati na pravo

prednosti te uz dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti dokaze iz članka 49. Zakona o

civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata. dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/84.

Između više kandidata koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja, Poslodavac zadržava pravo izbora u uži krug kandidata koji će biti pozvani na razgovor. Poslodavac zadržava pravo obaviti i testiranje kandidata.

Provjera znanja i sposobnosti kandidata provest će se putem usmenog razgovora (intervjua), tijekom kojeg će se procjenjivati osnovna i napredna stručna znanja iz područja elektrotehnike, automatike i elektronike, poznavanje SCADA i PLC sustava, sposobnost dijagnosticiranja i otklanjanja tehničkih kvarova, poznavanje rada s elektroničkom i upravljačkom opremom te analitičke, organizacijske i komunikacijske vještine potrebne za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati pristaju na obradu svojih osobnih podataka, u svrhu provođenja odabira kandidata. Sa dostavljenom dokumentacijom raspolažemo u skladu s Izjavom o zaštiti osobnih podataka objavljenoj na web stranici Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr /

Prijave za natječaj podnose se putem preporučene pošte na adresu: 23 000 Zadar, Špire Brusine 17 ili osobno na adresu sjedišta društva Vodovod d.o.o., Špire Brusine 17, 23 000 Zadar ili se podnose u elektroničkom obliku na e-mail adresu vodovod1@vodovod-zadar.hr a sve s naznakom „Natječaj za radno mjesto: Specijalist za automatiku i elektroniku „

Ovaj Natječaj objavljuje se na stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i web stranice Društva https://www.vodovod-zadar.hr/

Rok za predaju prijava je 19.11.2026. godine.

Prijave koje ne ispunjavaju uvjete iz natječaja, koje su pristigle van roka za predaju ili koje su nepotpune neće se uzeti u razmatranje.

Kandidati će biti obaviješteni o ishodu javnog natječaja.

Vodovod d.o.o. Zadar pridržava pravo poništiti javni natječaj u cijelosti ili djelomično u svakoj fazi postupka, bez obveze navođenja razloga.

jobs.title: Team Lead Accounts Payable (all genders) - in Prague, Prag (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Ist unsere Story auch deine Story? Wenn Kinder die authentischen Figuren und Spielsets von schleich® in die Hand nehmen, eröffnen sich wunderbare Fantasiewelten. Jeder Dinosaurier, jeder Elefant, jede Elfe ist der Beginn einer aufregenden Story. Unsere Vision: ,,Shaping Storytellers for life".  Und deine Geschichte bei schleich® beginnt hier.   Lass uns zusammen nicht nur die Freude am Geschichtenerzählen wecken, sondern auch die Story von schleich® weitererzählen ­- vom traditionellen Spielzeughersteller zur Global Love Brand. Werde Teil unserer aufregenden Transformationsstory.   Wir vertrauen dir, geben dir Ownership und die Möglichkeit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld international und digital zu arbeiten. Wir packen gemeinsam alle Herausforderungen an, die in der Zukunft noch auf uns warten. Nutze deine Chance, mit uns zu wachsen und wirklich etwas zu erreichen.   Working at Schleich. Make your mark.   Team Lead Accounts Payable (all genders) - in Prague Bitte beachte, dass diese Position im Rahmen unseres hybriden Arbeitsmodells in Prag angesiedelt ist. Umzugshilfe wird nicht angeboten. Folgende Abenteuer warten bei Schleich auf dich: Du möchtest ein Team führen, Prozesse verbessern und die Kreditorenbuchhaltung in einem internationalen Umfeld weiterentwickeln? Als Team Lead Accounts Payable in Prag übernimmst du bei Schleich die Verantwortung für den gesamten Prozess vom Rechnungseingang bis zur Zahlung. Du führst und entwickelst das AP-Team, stellst eine korrekte und termingerechte Bearbeitung sicher und treibst die Standardisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Abläufe voran. Teamführung: Du führst, coachst und entwickelst das AP-Team, setzt klare Prioritäten und sorgst für eine ausgewogene Aufgabenverteilung, regelmäßige Abstimmungen und transparente Verantwortlichkeiten. Rechnungsverarbeitung: Du steuerst den gesamten Rechnung-bis-Zahlung-Prozess in SAP und VIM - einschließlich der Dokumentation des Rechnungseingangs, der Workflow-Überwachung und der Klärung von Kontierungsfehlern, fehlenden Angaben und Freigabeverzögerungen. Offene Posten und Rückstände: Du überprüfst regelmäßig offene VIM-Vorgänge und überfällige oder gesperrte Rechnungen, stellst klare Zuständigkeiten und nächste Schritte sicher und treibst den Abbau von Rückständen voran. Zahlungsabwicklung: Du überwachst Zahlungsläufe, Freigaben sowie manuelle und dringende Zahlungen, stellst die zeitnahe Verbuchung sicher und stimmst Zahlungsprioritäten und Liquiditätsbedarf mit Treasury ab. Kontenabstimmung und Abschluss: Du verantwortest die Abstimmung von Lieferantenkonten, die Klärung nicht zugeordneter Zahlungen und Gutschriften sowie die termingerechte Durchführung der AP-Abschlussaktivitäten inklusive Unterstützung bei Abgrenzungen und Prüfungen. Freigaben und Compliance: Du stellst die Einhaltung interner Kontrollen, Freigabegrenzen und der Funktionstrennung sicher. Gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen entwickelst du Freigabematrizen, Bestellanforderungen und Kontierungsstandards weiter und koordinierst steuerliche sowie behördliche AP-Themen mit General Ledger und Tax. Zahlungskonditionen und Reisekosten: Du stellst korrekte Zahlungsbedingungen sowie die ordnungsgemäße Bearbeitung von Lastschriften und Reisekosten sicher und prüfst die Nutzung freigegebener, wirtschaftlich sinnvoller Skontomöglichkeiten. Kommunikation und Eskalationen: Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für AP-Eskalationen, sorgst für eine professionelle Lieferantenkommunikation und koordinierst Lösungen mit Einkauf, Controlling, General Ledger, Treasury, lokalen Finance-Teams und Rechnungsfreigebenden. Reporting und Verbesserung: Du überwachst relevante AP-Kennzahlen, etwa zu Rechnungsalter, Zahlungsfristen, Rückständen und Prozessqualität. Daraus leitest du Verbesserungen ab, dokumentierst Standards und treibst Automatisierung sowie die Reduzierung manueller Arbeit voran. Die Kapitel deiner bisherigen Story: Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung, idealerweise in einem internationalen Unternehmen oder Shared Service Center. Erfahrung in der Führung, Entwicklung oder Koordination eines AP-Teams sowie die Fähigkeit, Vertrauen aufzubauen und eine positive Zusammenarbeit zu fördern. Fundierte Kenntnisse der gesamten AP-Prozesskette, einschließlich Rechnungsworkflows, Zahlungen, Lieferantenkontenabstimmung und Reisekostenabrechnung. Praktische Erfahrung mit SAP, insbesondere FI/MM, und VIM sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Freigabeprozesse, interne Kontrollen und umsatzsteuerliche Anforderungen. Eine strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und pragmatische Arbeitsweise mit hoher Genauigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und Serviceorientierung. Die Fähigkeit, operative Prioritäten zu steuern und gleichzeitig Prozessverbesserungen voranzubringen. Überzeugende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen internen und externen Ansprechpartnern. Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse für die tägliche Zusammenarbeit im internationalen Umfeld.  Weder Königreiche noch Goldberge - aber viele andere Belohnungen: Kein Tag gleicht dem anderen, keine Karriere der anderen. Arbeite in einem dynamischen, abwechslungsreichen Umfeld, das dir individuelle Karriere- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bietet. Alle unsere Mitarbeitenden haben zudem Zugriff auf unzählige Onlinekurse unserer Weiterbildungsplattform Gemeinsam schreiben wir schleich® Geschichte. Werde Teil eines motivierten Teams, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und zusammen Erfolge feiert Dein Einstieg soll sich für dich lohnen! Wir bieten dir eine attraktive, faire Entlohnung mit Zusatzleistungen, die regelmäßig überprüft und aktualisiert werden Genieße außerdem die Vorteile eines hybriden Arbeitsmodells: 3 Tage im Office, 2 Tage Remote Bleib aktiv! Mit der MultiSport-Mitgliedschaft hast du Zugang zu zahlreichen Sport- und Freizeitangeboten Das schmeckt! Du erhältst einen Essenszuschuss von 82,60 CZK pro Arbeitstag Jeder Held und jede Heldin geht mal in Rente. Deshalb bieten wir dir eine geförderte Altersvorsorge Freu dich über tolle Rabatte auf unsere schleich® Produkte, die nicht nur Kinderherzen höherschlagen lassen Pause von den Abenteuern bei Schleich? Freu dich über 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr und ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell ohne Kernarbeitszeiten Du möchtest eine aktive Rolle in unserer Story spielen? Bitte beachte, dass Bewerbungen per E-Mail aus Datenschutzgründen nicht bearbeitet werden können. Wir freuen uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung. Das geht ganz einfach und schnell und stellt den Schutz deiner persönlichen Daten sicher. Dein Lebenslauf reicht aus.   Hast du noch Fragen zu den Aufgaben der Stelle oder zu deinem Bewerbungsstatus? jobs.title: (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) - Siemens Advanta (Physiker/in)
jobs.description: As an (Associate) Vice President (f/m/d) at Siemens Advanta’s Strategy and Innovation Practice, you will serve as a senior leader overseeing pivotal domains: Delivery, Business Development, and People & Capability Building. Leveraging advanced expertise and leadership acumen, you will help define the next era of digitalization by crafting groundbreaking strategies and transformation roadmaps for Siemens and its global customers. The role entails direct responsibility for shaping business success, managing high-value projects, and serving as a trusted advisor for customer executives at C-level.Building on Siemens Advanta’s legacy as a global management consultancy powerhouse, the (Associate) Vice President role combines strategic depth, operational ownership, and cultural leadership—providing exposure to innovation-driven industries such as electrification, automation, and digitalization. **Ready to take your vision to the next level? Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee multidisciplinary teams in complex consulting engagements and large-scale programs to deliver innovative, tailored digital and organizational solutions for global industrial customers.- Business Growth:- Shape strategic customer opportunities through thought leadership, innovative methodologies, and differentiated consulting approaches at the intersection of strategy, digitalization, and technology.- Lead the development of compelling value propositions, proposals, and solution concepts for complex transformation initiatives in close collaboration with Customer Partners and senior customer stakeholders.- Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, acting as a strategic advisor and fostering long-term partnerships across complex stakeholder environments.- Leverage Siemens’ unique expertise in industrial technology, automation, digitalization, and AI to create measurable value for customers and strengthen Siemens Advanta’s market positioning and growth.- People & Capability Building- Develop differentiating methodologies, foster team growth, mentor employees, and build Consulting Excellence within the organization.- Inspire, coach, and grow high-performing, diverse teams ensuring an inclusive, performance-oriented consulting culture.What you bring:- Education: - Master’s degree or MBA from a top-tier university is desirable.- Backgrounds in engineering, physics, natural sciences, or strategic management are highly valued.- Experience & Skills- Extensive consulting experience (8 - 12+ years), with a proven track record as Principal, (Associate) Partner or VP at a top-tier strategy consultancy, or equivalent experience in corporate strategy roles.- Track record in driving significant business growth**,** leading large-scale transformation programs, and building executive-level customer relationships.- Proven track record in leading digital transformation projects for Siemens’ customer base, focusing on industries like automotive and power & utilities.- AI expertise: Strong familiarity with AI-based strategy development and execution, leveraging AI to create impactful industry transformations.- End-to-end experience, ranging from strategy development to hands-on execution for technology-driven and industry-specific transformation projects.- Methodological depth in areas such as Target Operating Model (TOM), cost reduction initiatives, sustainability, and AI transformation.- Working Style & Personality- Ability to thrive in a matrix organization, fostering strong internal partnerships and cross-functional collaboration.- Extensive experience leading international teams and actively creating an inclusive environment.- A leader who develops people, enjoys leading employees, brings diverse perspectives, thinks creatively, and goes beyond standard consulting approaches.- An entrepreneurial mindset and strong analytical acumen.- Languages: The position can be filled in either Munich,Germany or Barcelona,Spain.- Pathway 1: For candidates working in Munich and supporting primarily German-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in English is mandatory, while German is an advantage.- Pathway 2: For candidates working in Barcelona and supporting primarily Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in Spanish is mandatory, with proficiency in Portugese preferred.What we offer you- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usSiemens Advanta provides consulting services in the fields of strategy, operations, AI, and data analytics, as well as solution implementation services, to enable the digital and sustainability transformation of Siemens customers. Leveraging Siemens’ expertise, resources, and its ecosystem of businesses and partners, customers are empowered to unlock the full potential of Siemens technologies. Siemens Advanta elevates customer engagements to an enterprise level, leading transformations through strategic insight and holistic solutions. With pioneering projects bridging across Siemens’ entire portfolio, customers are enabled to leverage the full value of Siemens technologies. With this, Siemens Advanta develops repeatable, scalable and proven solutions that maximize customer value across the entire value chain. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, Siemens Advanta operates through a global network of around 800 employees across 18 countries.www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.de/careers) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (http://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/karrieren-entdecken.html)  – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.description:
Lev-Vel er en af Danmarks største private hjemmeplejevirksomheder. Siden 2007 har vi leveret omsorg, tryghed og høj faglighed til borgere i Lolland-, Faxe-, Vordingborg-, Guldborgsund- og Næstved Kommune.

I dag er vi mere end 200 engagerede medarbejdere, og vi vækster fortsat. Derfor søger vi nu flere dygtige Social og sundhedshjælpere til vores afdeling i Faxe Kommune.

Hos Lev-Vel tror vi på, at stabile relationer skaber den bedste pleje. Vi prioriterer derfor kontinuitet, nærvær og høj kvalitet i mødet med borgeren. Vores mål er enkelt: Borgerne skal have det bedre, når vi går, end da vi kom.

Vi hjælper borgere med både personlig pleje, praktisk hjælp samt private tilkøbsydelser – altid med respekt for den enkelte borgers ønsker og behov.

jobs.title: Make Things Happen: We’re Hiring a Contract Manager Who Loves Action!
jobs.description:
Do you love the buzz of a fast-moving environment where you get real responsibility and make an impact from day one? Do you want to join a team of bold, curious and driven people who are building something extraordinary together? Does negotiating excite you? Then you might just be the Contract Manager we are looking for.

About us

Since 1981, Delta of Scandinavia has been crafting unforgettable travel experiences across the Nordics, from the magic of Iceland’s northern lights to the timeless beauty of Norway’s fjords. Luxury escapes, wild adventures, sustainable journeys: all designed with passion, creativity and a true love for the North.

What do we offer

Join a young, international team where ideas travel fast and every day feels different.

Work in a vibrant environment that inspires creativity, collaboration and fun.

Grow fast, with real career opportunities and intense hands-on training that will boost your skills from day one.

Your responsibilities

As Contract Manager you negotiate and manage our supplier agreements, securing the best commercial conditions and building strong partnerships. Your work supports product quality, operational efficiency and our wider company objectives.

You will be involved in many exciting areas, including:

•      Identify, collect, analyse and negotiate a wide variety of contracts with suppliers. Optimise every agreement to maximise value and keep Delta competitive.

•      Ensure that all contractual terms align with company standards and objectives.

•      Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with suppliers, and act as the main point of contact for contractual matters.

•      Foster collaboration with suppliers to improve product quality and commercial outcomes.

•      Troubleshoot contract-related issues.

•      Make sure that booking procedures with suppliers work well, and identify and implement solutions that improve processes and efficiency.

•      Be in contact with the Department Managers to establish the strategy for the product and stay aware of the departments’ needs.

•      Contribute insights that support product strategy and development.

•      Collaborate with destination partners to stay up to date on product knowledge and market developments, and make sure Delta is involved in the strategies of the Tourist Boards and DMOs, including invitations to events and FAM trips.

•      Keep the communication about the product flowing between staff at all times: exchange news and keep a regular update.

What we expect from you

You bring an exceptional work ethic and a strong sense of urgency. You are driven by ambition and always push yourself to reach the highest standards. You take full ownership of your work, and you are proactive, reliable and committed to delivering results. At the same time, you stay humble and share our enthusiasm for creating and growing new ventures.

We love working from the office: it is where teamwork, creativity and growth truly thrive, when we are together in person. From 1 December 2026 our office will be located at Axeltårn: difficult to find a better location in town.

jobs.title: Külaliskorterite koristaja
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Dream Stay OÜ on pikaajalise kogemusega lühiajalise rendiga tegelev ettevõte, kelle hallata on üle 120 külaliskorteri Tallinnas. Otsime oma meeskonda külaliskorterite koristajaid nii täis- kui osalise koormusega. Võimalik on töötada ka ainult nädalavahetustel (näiteks laupäevast esmaspäevani) — töö sobib hästi lisatööks. Enamik külaliskortereid asub Tallinna vanalinnas ja kesklinnas või nende vahetus läheduses. Pakume tööd külaliskorterites. Palun arvestage, et kõik korterid – kokku umbes 120 – asuvad erinevates hoonetes. Autot tööks vaja ei ole — liikumine objektide vahel toimub ühistranspordiga ning see aeg on samuti tasustatud. Linna peal pesu vedama ei pea: puhta pesu toob kohale meie kuller. Kõik vajalikud puhastusvahendid on olemas apartementides või keldriruumides. Koristaja peab endaga kaasas kandma vaid meilt saadud lappe, kindaid ja mõned švammid. Töö sisaldab vahetusi nädalavahetustel ja pühade ajal — see on turismisektoris töötamise loomulik osa. Esmaspäevast reedeni töögraafikut kahjuks pakkuda ei ole võimalik ning väikeste lastega tööl viibimine ei ole lubatud.

Omalt poolt pakume: * Kaasaegseid töövahendeid* Sõbralikku ning toetavat kollektiivi * Töötulemustele vastavat töötasu

Muud nõuded: Oled sobiv kandidaat, kui sul on olemas töötahe, armastad puhtust ja korrektsust ning oled võimeline töötama iseseisvalt. jobs.title: Sales Manager – Packaging Equipment and Automated Packaging Solutions
jobs.description:
Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Automated packaging lines and packaging equipment.

Work tasks: Alpina Electronics OÜ is expanding its activities in the field of automated packaging equipment and packaging lines and is looking for a Sales Manager for the Estonian and Finnish markets. Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Our range of solutions includes: Automated packaging lines and equipment in cooperation with the Polish manufacturer RADPAK. Palletizing equipment, including solutions developed by Alpina Electronics. Thermoforming packaging machines for the food industry, primarily for the Finnish market, supplied by Colimatic. Your Key Responsibilities Identifying potential customers and establishing new business relationships in Estonia and Finland. Visiting customers to understand their production processes and packaging requirements. Presenting suitable packaging equipment and automated packaging solutions. Working closely with equipment manufacturers and technical specialists. Managing sales projects from initial customer contact through to order confirmation. Every manufacturing company and project is different. Your role will be to understand each customer's specific needs and work together with our team and the manufacturers' technical specialists to develop the most suitable solution.

We offer: We offer an opportunity to play an active role in establishing a new sales division and developing the market for automated packaging equipment and packaging lines in Estonia and Finland. We offer: A competitive base salary combined with performance-based bonuses. An independent and responsible position with a high degree of autonomy. Flexible working arrangements, including the opportunity to work from home. A company car, computer, mobile phone, and all other necessary work equipment. Comprehensive technical support from equipment manufacturers and our own specialists. Manufacturer-provided training and opportunities to attend international trade fairs. The opportunity to contribute to the development of a new business area and influence the range of solutions we offer. The position involves regular customer visits throughout Estonia and Finland. Administrative and office-based tasks can be carried out from a home office. We prefer a full-time employee but are also open to part-time arrangements for the right candidate.

Other requirements: This position is ideal for someone who values independence, enjoys planning their own work, and wants to see a direct connection between their efforts and achievements.

Option to work from home: Yes

Working load, shifts: 0,5

jobs.title: Principal Revenue Strategist
Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager
Senior Raft Guide & Safety Kayaker / Kayak leiðbeinandi
jobs.description: Arctic Rafting is looking for a Senior Raft Guide and Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor for the upcoming summer season of 2027. Our season is May – September, with our high season in the summer time; June – August. There are some operations and preparations to do also before and after, in April and October. In particular, we are looking for someone to come in March, to repair equipment and do admin office work for the river operation, to prepare for the summer. This position will extend to be all year round, working part time over the winter months and taking a long leave (1-3 months). Arctic Rafting has a base camp on the well known tourist circuit of “The Golden Circle” in the southern part of Iceland, in just over an hour drive from Reykjavík capital city. Our operations include family friendly rafting trips on the mighty Hvítá River (class II-III), which is the third longest river in Iceland, originating from Langjökull Glacier. Our base camp has other amenities like a bar, restaurant, sauna and hot tubs, so clients can wind down after an action-packed adventure on the river.The qualities we are looking for is experience with good customer service, and good team work skills. Any added language skills are appreciated, operational skills for safe and high quality river trips, repairing skills for river rafting gear and other equipment, and skills for cooking, cleaning, photography, marketing/office, mechanics and general handy man skills. Job description and responsibilities of a Senior Raft Guide:* Operate safe and entertaining river tours for clients (rafting or kayaking)* Be a team leader and trip lead a group of guides in rafting trips of the size of 100+ clients* Kitchen worker and general work in the restaurant and bar serving clients* Work around the property (repair gear, cleaning, laundry, gardening and handy man jobs)Requirements:* Current WRT (Whitewater Rescue Technician) or similar* Current IRF (International Rafting Federation) certification or similar* Up to date Advanced First Aid training* Minimum 5 seasons of raft guide experience* Good English skills to communicate with clientsExtras, good to have, but not a requirement:* A big bus license to drive the river shuttle (45 seater)* Kitchen and bar experience* Photography skills* Sales / marketing skillsWork arrangements:* We generally have one morning trip and one afternoon trip every day; you either do two trips per day, or one trip and then base work for the rest of the day (cooking, cleaning, repair gear, etc.)* The work days can be anything from 4-12 hours per day, but the normality is generally 8-9 hours* A full time job means 160-170 hours per month, and as the hours vary, the pay is by hourly rates* Normally you would get 2 days off per week, but this can vary to 1-3 days off weeklyHousing and food:* Living arrangements is at an old farm in the countryside 1,5 hour from Reykjavík city, next to the river rafting base / restaurant* Everyone gets their own private room, including shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* We do daily communal dinners and everyone is expected to partake in the cooking and cleaning at the end of the day* We supply breakfast, lunch and dinner; while you are at the raft base for work Rates:* Depending on your skill level and experience the pay would be around 2.500 – 2.900isk per hour* In addition to this we offer free housing and food for your stay during your work periodPlease note that in Iceland we pay around 40% tax, and other fees will be deducted too (union, pension fund etc.)Benefits:* Some great times living in the countryside, being a raft guide for an Icelandic summer season* Private room with shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* Use of base facilities (staff kitchen, hot pots and sauna)* Occasional use of communal work car; we strongly recommend having a valid driver’s license, as public transport in Iceland is quite horrid when you live at an old farm in the middle of nowhere.About the Company:This is one of the oldest adventure activities to do in Iceland, but the first river rafting trip with clients was made here in 1985. Around 1990 they started renovations at the old barn and farm house to make the raft base into what it is today; changing rooms, showers, sauna, hot pots, restaurant, bar and guide facilities; for around 10-12 staff members to live there for the summer season. Our clients are mostly from Iceland, Europe and USA, so the minimal language requirements are good English skills. Owned by a local raft guide and kayaker, and more details can be found on our website: www.arcticrafting.com This video sums up what a normal day in the summer looks like – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQTo apply; please send a CV and cover letter to drumbo@arcticrafting.is before 1st of December 2026Best regards,The Arctic Rafting teamdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.comArctic Rafting leitar að reyndum flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanni (Senior Raft Guide) og öryggiskajakræðara/kajakkennara (Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor) fyrir komandi sumartímabil árið 2027.Starfstímabilið okkar er frá maí til september, en háannatíminn er yfir sumarmánuðina, júní til ágúst. Einnig þarf að sinna ýmsum undirbúnings- og rekstrarverkefnum fyrir og eftir tímabilið, í apríl og október.Við leitum sérstaklega að einstaklingi sem getur hafið störf í mars til að sinna viðgerðum á búnaði og skrifstofu- og stjórnsýsluverkefnum tengdum flúðasiglingarekstrinum, til undirbúnings fyrir sumarið.Starfið mun þróast yfir í heilsársstarf, þar sem unnið verður í hlutastarfi yfir vetrarmánuðina og möguleiki verður á lengra leyfi, í 1–3 mánuði.StarfsumhverfiðArctic Rafting er með bækistöð við hina þekktu ferðamannaleið Gullna hringinn á Suðurlandi, í rúmlega klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík.Starfsemin felur meðal annars í sér fjölskylduvænar flúðasiglingaferðir á hinni mikilfenglegu Hvítá (erfiðleikaflokkur II–III). Hvítá er þriðja lengsta á Íslands og á upptök sín við Langjökul.Á bækistöðinni er einnig bar, veitingastaður, gufubað og heitir pottar þar sem gestir geta slakað á eftir ævintýralega ferð niður ána.Eiginleikar sem við leitum aðVið leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur reynslu af góðri þjónustu við viðskiptavini og býr yfir góðri hæfni í teymisvinnu.Önnur tungumálakunnátta er kostur, sem og færni í að skipuleggja og framkvæma öruggar og vandaðar flúðasiglingaferðir.Einnig er kostur að hafa reynslu af viðgerðum á flúðasiglingabúnaði og öðrum tækjum, matreiðslu, þrifum, ljósmyndun, markaðssetningu, skrifstofustörfum, vélaviðgerðum og almennum viðhaldsverkefnum.Starfslýsing og ábyrgð yfirleiðsögumannsStjórna öruggum og skemmtilegum flúðasiglinga- og kajakferðum fyrir viðskiptavini.Vera leiðtogi teymis og stýra hópi leiðsögumanna í flúðasiglingaferðum með yfir 100 þátttakendum.Vinna í eldhúsi og sinna almennum störfum á veitingastað og bar, þar á meðal þjónustu við gesti.Sinna ýmsum verkefnum á svæðinu, svo sem viðgerðum á búnaði, þrifum, þvotti, garðvinnu og almennu viðhaldi.HæfniskröfurGilt WRT-skírteini (Whitewater Rescue Technician – sérhæfð björgun í straumvatni) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild IRF-réttindi (International Rafting Federation – Alþjóðasamband flúðasiglinga) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild og uppfærð réttindi í ítarlegri skyndihjálp (Advanced First Aid).Að lágmarki fimm tímabils reynsla sem flúðasiglingaleiðsögumaður.Góð enskukunnátta til að eiga samskipti við viðskiptavini.Viðbótarhæfni sem er kostur en ekki skilyrðiÖkuréttindi til að aka stórri rútu (45 farþega) sem notuð er til að flytja gesti til og frá ánni.Reynsla af eldhús- og barstörfum.Hæfni í ljósmyndun.Reynsla af sölu- og markaðsmálum.Vinnutími og starfskjörYfirleitt eru farnar tvær flúðasiglingaferðir á dag, ein að morgni og önnur síðdegis.Starfsmaður fer annaðhvort í tvær ferðir á dag eða eina ferð og sinnir síðan öðrum verkefnum á bækistöðinni, svo sem matreiðslu, þrifum eða viðgerðum á búnaði.Vinnudagar geta verið allt frá 4 upp í 12 klukkustundir, en algengast er að þeir séu um 8–9 klukkustundir.Fullt starf miðast við 160–170 vinnustundir á mánuði. Þar sem vinnustundir eru breytilegar eru laun greidd samkvæmt tímakaupi.Yfirleitt eru tveir frídagar í viku, en þeir geta verið frá einum upp í þrjá eftir aðstæðum.Húsnæði og fæðiStarfsfólk býr á gömlum sveitabæ í um 1,5 klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík, við hliðina á flúðasiglingabækistöðinni og veitingastaðnum.Allir starfsmenn fá sérherbergi en deila sameiginlegri aðstöðu, þar á meðal baðherbergi með sturtu.Sameiginlegur kvöldverður er á hverjum degi og ætlast er til að allir taki þátt í matreiðslu og frágangi í lok dags.Boðið er upp á morgunmat, hádegismat og kvöldmat á meðan starfsfólk er við vinnu á bækistöðinni.LaunTímakaup fer eftir hæfni og reynslu viðkomandi og er á bilinu 2.500–2.900 krónur á klukkustund.Auk launa er boðið upp á ókeypis húsnæði og fæði meðan á starfstímabilinu stendur.Athugið að á Íslandi geta skattar numið um 40% af launum og að önnur gjöld eru einnig dregin frá, svo sem stéttarfélagsgjöld og lífeyrissjóðsiðgjöld.FríðindiEinstakt tækifæri til að upplifa íslenskt sumar í sveitinni og starfa við flúðasiglingar.Sérherbergi með sameiginlegri baðaðstöðu.Aðgangur að aðstöðu á bækistöðinni, þar á meðal starfsmannaeldhúsi, heitum pottum og gufubaði.Stundum er hægt að nýta sameiginlegan starfsmannabíl.Við mælum eindregið með því að umsækjendur hafi gilt ökuskírteini, þar sem almenningssamgöngur á Íslandi eru afar takmarkaðar þegar búið er á gömlum sveitabæ úti í sveit.Um fyrirtækiðFlúðasiglingar eru ein elsta skipulagða ævintýraafþreying sem boðið hefur verið upp á á Íslandi. Fyrsta flúðasiglingaferðin með viðskiptavini á þessu svæði var farin árið 1985.Um 1990 hófst endurnýjun á gamla fjósinu og íbúðarhúsinu á bænum með það að markmiði að útbúa þá aðstöðu sem þar er í dag.Þar er nú að finna búningsklefa, sturtur, gufubað, heita potta, veitingastað, bar og aðstöðu fyrir leiðsögumenn. Á sumrin er aðstaða fyrir um 10–12 starfsmenn til að búa á staðnum.Viðskiptavinir okkar koma að mestu leyti frá Íslandi, Evrópu og Bandaríkjunum og því er góð enskukunnátta lágmarkskrafa.Fyrirtækið er í eigu flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanns og kajakræðara úr heimabyggð.Nánari upplýsingar um fyrirtækið má finna á vefsíðunni:www.arcticrafting.comMyndband sem sýnir dæmigerðan sumardag hjá Arctic Rafting:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQUmsóknir:Áhugasamir eru beðnir um að senda ferilskrá og kynningarbréf á netfangið:drumbo@arcticrafting.isUmsóknarfrestur er til 1. desember 2026.Með bestu kveðju,Starfsfólk Arctic Raftingdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.com

jobs.description:
Har du en solid grøn faglighed, trives du med at tage fat, og kan du lide at arbejde selvstændigt i et tæt makkerskab? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til at holde Skjoldhøjparken grøn, sikker og i topform hele året.

Skjoldhøjparkens Grundejerforening søger en dygtig og engageret gartner til den daglige drift af vores fælles områder. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med en anden gartner og få en varieret hverdag, hvor du er med til at sikre, at området fremstår pænt, sikkert og velplejet hele året.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver en del af et lille team på to gartnere ansat af bestyrelsen, og dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Klippe græs og pleje områdets grønne arealer

  • Udføre snerydning og glatførebekæmpelse i vinterhalvåret

  • Beskæring af træer og buske

  • Vedligeholde og tjekke områdets legepladser

  • Have den daglige dialog med leverandører og samarbejdspartnere samt følge op på aftalte opgaver

  • Løse lettere administrative opgaver digitalt

  • Løse øvrige driftsopgaver i området, som opstår hen over året

  • Bidrage til gode arbejdsgange og fortløbende forbedringer i driften

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet gartner, anlægsgartner, landmand, bygningsservicetekniker eller har en anden relevant grøn uddannelse. Det vigtigste er, at du har praktisk erfaring, kan arbejde med frihed under ansvar og finder stor glæde ved pleje og vedligeholdelse af grønne områder.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og pålideligt

  • Er god til at samarbejde og dele opgaverne med din kollega

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt og venligt med leverandører og med områdets beboere

  • Kan overskue og prioritere, når vejr og årstid ændrer opgaverne

  • Har almindelige IT-kompetencer

 

Det er en fordel, hvis du:

  • Har erfaring med drift af større boligområder, grundejerforeninger eller lignende

  • Kan lide at snakke med beboere i området

  • Har kendskab til kontrol og vedligeholdelse af legepladser

  • Har erfaring med at arbejde med leverandører og indhente tilbud

  • Kan udføre let administrativt arbejde

Vi tilbyder

  • En alsidig stilling med praktisk arbejde og ansvar for områdets drift

  • Et tæt samarbejde med en gartnerkollega

  • Frihed under ansvar og mulighed for at præge arbejdsgangene

  • Et arbejdsmiljø, hvor du kommer tæt på de mennesker, der bor og færdes i området

Praktiske oplysninger

  • Du skal have gyldigt kørekort til kategori B

  • Du skal kunne stå til rådighed for snerydning i vinterhalvåret

  • Arbejdstid 37 timer ugentligt

  • Arbejdspladsen er Fejøvænget 33, 8381 Tilst

  • Tiltrædelse snarest muligt

  • Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst ved 3F

Ansøgning

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og opslaget tages ned, når den rette er fundet.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV via job@skjoldhoj.dk, hvor alle ansøgninger behandles fortroligt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte bestyrelsen på kontakt@skjoldhoj.dk

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion's engineering and product teams are shipping faster than ever, which means there's more for customers to discover, understand, and adopt than ever before. We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to drive awareness of new Notion features and capabilities, and to run the programs that turn early activation into lasting adoption. This is a full-stack role: you'll flex across launches, growth programs, and pricing and packaging. That last one means helping decide how new capabilities map to plans and tiers, and making sure customers can tell what they get and what they pay for. You're a messaging master with a genuine point of view: someone who can build narratives sharp and specific enough to cut through an increasingly noisy market, and a strategic partner to Product from early development all the way through go-to-market.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead launches big and small, coordinating efforts across our Marketing and GTM org to land a successful launch day.

 - Drive continued awareness, growth, and adoption of high-PMF features well after launch day. Launch is the start of the story, not the end of it.

 - Take on pricing and packaging projects for new capabilities, working with Product, Design, and Web to decide whether something becomes a new SKU or tier or joins an existing one, then landing the change on notion.com/pricing http://notion.com/pricing, in-product, and in release comms.

 - Serve as a strategic partner to Product, informing strategy during product development, competitive positioning, and user insights.

 - Collaborate with Enterprise PMMs and Sales to build sales enablement materials that turn product capability into stories reps can use in the field.

 - Partnering with Demand Gen and Lifecycle on sequences, webinars, and more.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 10+ years directly relevant experience in product marketing or adjacent marketing function.

 - A distinctive point of view and the creativity to build narratives that stand out in a crowded, noisy market.

 - Experience running product launches, adoption, or growth programs, ideally at a fast-moving product or technology company.

 - A real point of view on pricing and packaging, or the appetite to build one fast. You can reason about plans, tiers, and value, not just features and launches.

 - Strong cross-functional skills, comfortable coordinating Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing toward one outcome.

 - Genuine passion for shaping the future of work with AI, a growth mindset, and a scrappy, high-ownership approach to getting things done.

 - Sharp writing and storytelling instincts: you know the difference between a headline that's technically accurate and one that actually lands.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're already a Notion user, fluent in the product and plugged into the community.

 - You look beyond just AI & tech companies for creative inspiration

 - You're a pro at building and using agents, inside Notion and beyond.

 - You've worked through a pricing or packaging change before, such as a new tier, a plan change, or a paywall, and can talk about the tradeoffs.

 - PMM experience at a larger company, though we care more about your instincts and ownership than your resume's logos.

As we scale globally, we need someone who can ensure our revenue teams are equipped with the knowledge, tools, and processes to succeed across every geography while maintaining our core values and approach to customer relationships.



We're looking for a Revenue Enablement Program Manager to turn our global enablement strategy into repeatable programs that drive measurable changes in how our revenue teams work. You'll partner with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Product Marketing, onboarding teams, and frontline managers to equip the field with the skills, workflows, and just-in-time guidance to execute our GTM strategy. You'll design for practice and proficiency, enable managers to coach and reinforce new behaviors, and use adoption and business signals to continuously improve programs.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

Global Program Development & Implementation

Review results regularly, distinguish correlation from causation, and recommend corrective action when adoption or performance is off track

AMER activation & regional adaptation

 - Collaborate with regional segment leads to proactively identify segment & market dynamics, competitive landscapes, and customer behavior patterns

 - Adapt global programs to address regional needs while maintaining core methodology and brand consistency

 - Create region-specific content, case studies, and competitive battle cards that resonate with local markets

 - Build feedback loops between regional teams and global program development to continuously improve our approach

 - Partner with regional managers to coach, inspect, and reinforce priority behaviors in existing team cadences; use field feedback to improve adoption and program design




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

Experience & Expertise

 - 7-10+ years of experience in sales enablement, revenue operations, or similar go-to-market roles

 - Proven track record of building and scaling enablement programs across multiple geographies, with a consistent global core and effective regional adaptation

 - Expertise in adult learning methodologies and designing multimodal experiences that build and assess proficiency through practice, application, and reinforcement

 - High proficiency with the enablement tool stack including emerging AI and automation solutions (ideally AI is already embedded into your workflow)

 - Experience working with global sales teams and understanding of diverse market dynamics

 - Strong analytical skills and experience defining target behaviors, tracking leading indicators and business outcomes, and improving programs based on evidence

Skills & Qualities

 - Demonstrate ability to build and automate Enablement and field work through AI workflows

 - Strategic thinker who can balance global consistency with local relevance

 - Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable working with senior leadership

 - Natural collaborator who thrives in cross-functional environments

 - Data-driven approach to decision making with strong attention to detail

 - Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-growing environment

 - Passionate about developing people and helping teams reach their potential

Technical Requirements

 - Proficiency with AI tools for workflow development, gamification, content creation, data analysis, and process automation

 - Strong project management skills with experience managing multiple initiatives simultaneously

 - Experience enabling frontline managers to coach and reinforce new behaviors

 - Ability to build or support technical and workflow fluency programs that connect customer needs to practical solutions

 - Comfortable with sales analytics and performance metrics




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience at a high-growth SaaS company

 - Background in sales, customer success, or revenue-generating roles

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager, Europe
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts.

We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager in Europe to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in Europe, with London preferred. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings.

What you’ll do

 - Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner

 - Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there

 - Manage venues and vendors, negotiate menus and minimums, and keep per-dinner spend, contracts, and travel logistics within budget

 - Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward

 - Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots

 - Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up

 - Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners

What we’re looking for

 - 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus

 - A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings

 - Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened

 - Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details

 - Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus

 - Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus

 - Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run

 - Willingness to travel often, including evenings

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vqDYkuzbSM

 - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear

 - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality

jobs.title: Mechanical Technician
jobs.description: **About Ioncell Oy**Are you looking for a versatile and inspiring role where you can build, run and maintain a unique pilot plant? Ioncell Oy is now building a team of aspirational and committed professionals to kick off the operations in Otaniemi, Espoo. You will be one of our very first employees.Ioncell Oy is a technology spinoff company from Aalto University, established to commercialize patented Ioncell technology over the coming years. We are on a bold mission to transform the global clothing and textile industry into a circular economy with our fully circular bio-based textile fiber! As a company, our short-term goal is to provide a Proof-of-Concept for continuous, closed-loop production at the pilot plant, and then to scale up the technology.**What are your responsibilities**We are looking for a self-driven and solution-oriented Mechanical Technician to join our team. jobs.title: Research and Development Engineer in Artificial Intelligence (H/F)
jobs.description: Who we are ?Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools.The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing potential attacks, understanding the strategies available to attackers and defenders, and verifying that critical security properties are preserved. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. However, applying these techniques to realistic systems remains challenging. Verification problems can involve large state spaces and complex strategic interactions, while constructing formal models and specifying security properties often requires specialised expertise.The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges by combining formal verification with artificial intelligence. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for analysing cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. The project also investigates how AI can improve the efficiency and accessibility of these verification processes.A central objective of VITAMIN-C is to integrate AI techniques into the verification workflow. On the computational side, AI models will be investigated to guide the exploration of large state spaces and prioritise promising verification strategies. By learning from previously verified models and their associated results, these components can help identify relevant search directions and reduce the computational effort required by verification algorithms. On the usability side, the project explores AI-assisted interfaces that support engineers in constructing formal models and specifying security properties. These interfaces may exploit natural-language processing and large language models to interpret engineering descriptions, suggest formal representations, and assist users throughout the verification process. In both cases, the correctness of verification results remains the responsibility of the underlying formal methods, which validate the outcomes produced or suggested by AI components.Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of AI techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on developing AI components for verification guidance, investigating natural-language and LLM-based assistance for formal modelling, and integrating these capabilities into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in the preparation of training and evaluation datasets, the development of experimental benchmarks, and the assessment of the proposed approaches in terms of effectiveness, computational efficiency, and reliability. The overall objective is to make formal verification more scalable and accessible while preserving the rigorous guarantees provided by the verification framework.Your main responsibilities will include :Carry out R&D work in artificial intelligence for formal verificationContribute to the research profile of Télécom Paris and Institut Mines-Télécom

jobs.title: Konstruktionsingeniør til STEENBERGs tegnestue
jobs.description:
Vil du arbejde med bærende konstruktioner og være med til at omsætte skitser og beregninger til byggeri, der fungerer i praksis? Og trives du med en varieret hverdag, hvor statiske beregninger går hånd i hånd med tilsyn, byggetekniske gennemgange og tæt samarbejde med kollegaer, håndværkere og bygherrer?

Hos STEENBERGs tegnestue på Bornholm søger vi en konstruktionsingeniør, der har lyst til at arbejde bredt med både statik og praktiske, byggetekniske opgaver.

Om stillingen

Du bliver en del af projekter med nybyggeri, ombygninger og renoveringer i forskellige størrelser og med varierende kompleksitet. Vi arbejder som totalrådgiver, og du får mulighed for at følge løsningerne fra de første overvejelser og beregninger til udførelsen på byggepladsen.

Arbejdet spænder fra klassiske statikopgaver med beregninger, tegninger og dokumentation til mindre og større byggetekniske problemstillinger. Det kan eksempelvis være en håndværker, der står med en konkret udfordring på byggepladsen og har brug for din hjælp til at finde en byggeteknisk holdbar og bygbar løsning.

Du bliver en del af et tæt fagligt samarbejde på tegnestuen, hvor vi bringer vores forskellige kompetencer i spil. Inden for statik får du en stærk sparringspartner, som du kan drøfte beregninger, konkrete løsninger og byggetekniske problemstillinger med.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Projektering og beregning af beton-, stål- og trækonstruktioner.

  • Udarbejdelse af statisk dokumentation, tegninger og konstruktionsdetaljer.

  • Byggeteknisk rådgivning og løsning af konkrete problemstillinger i dialog med håndværkere og bygherrer.

  • Byggetekniske gennemgange og fagtilsyn.

  • Samarbejde og koordinering med tegnestuens øvrige faggrupper.

  • Eventuelt byggeledelse.

Du lærer tegnestuens arbejdsmetoder og igangværende sager at kende i samarbejde med dine kollegaer. Undervejs får du ansvar for egne opgaver med mulighed for sparring om både beregninger og byggetekniske løsninger.

Hvem er du?

Du er uddannet ingeniør med speciale i bærende konstruktioner og har en praktisk tilgang til dine opgaver. Du interesserer dig for sammenhængen mellem beregninger, materialer og udførelse og har blik for både bygbarhed og økonomi.

En håndværksmæssig baggrund vil være en fordel. Erfaring fra byggepladsen er værdifuld, når du skal forstå en konkret problemstilling og finde en løsning i dialog med dem, der skal udføre arbejdet.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

  • Har en bred konstruktionsmæssig forståelse og lyst til at arbejde med både statik og byggetekniske opgaver.

  • Har erfaring med relevante beregningsværktøjer, eksempelvis StruSoft Dimension og FEM Design.

  • Kan omsætte din faglige viden til praktiske og gennemarbejdede løsninger.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

  • Kan forklare tekniske forhold forståeligt til både bygherrer og håndværkere.

  • Bidrager til den faglige sparring og er åben for andres erfaringer.

En tegnestue med korte veje mellem faglighederne

På STEENBERGs tegnestue løser vi opgaverne i fællesskab. Vi bringer vores forskellige kompetencer i spil og hjælper hinanden med at skabe sammenhæng mellem arkitektur, konstruktioner og installationer.

Hverdagen er præget af en flad struktur, fagligt engagement og en uformel, humoristisk omgangstone. Du får mulighed for at påvirke dit arbejde og bidrage med dine erfaringer og idéer.

Vi tilbyder frokostordning, pension med sundhedsforsikring og løn efter kvalifikationer.

Interesseret?

Kontakt Anders Bjerregaard på 56 95 53 30, hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen.

Send ansøgning og CV til ab@steenberg.dk. Fortæl gerne om projekter, du har arbejdet med, og hvilke opgaver du har løst.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kollega. Tiltrædelse aftaler vi sammen.

jobs.title: Restaurationsbestyrer søges til La Viva
jobs.description:
Engageret Restaurationsbestyrer søges til La Viva

Er du en passioneret leder med hjertet bankende for branchen, og brænder du for at skabe uforglemmelige gæsteoplevelser? La Viva Slagelse ApS udvider og søger en driftig og ansvarsbevidst restaurationsbestyrer til vores afdeling i Køge: La Viva Køge og Slagelse.

Om stillingen

Som restaurationsbestyrer får du det overordnede ansvar for den daglige drift af La Viva Køge eller Slagelse. Du bliver omdrejningspunktet for både gæster og personale, og det bliver din fornemmeste opgave at sikre, at restauranten altid leverer høj kvalitet og fantastisk service. Stillingen er formelt klassificeret under DISCO-kode 141200, som dækker over detaljeret arbejdsfunktion og ledelse af hovedaktiviteten inden for restauration.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil inkludere:

  • Daglig ledelse, motivation og vagtplanlægning af et dynamisk og serviceminded team.

  • Sikring af et højt serviceniveau og gæstetilfredshed i særklasse.

  • Økonomistyring, herunder budgetansvar, varelager, svindkontrol og indkøb.

  • Kvalitetssikring af mad, drikkevarer og hygiejnestandarder (egenkontrol).

  • Udvikling af restaurantens koncepter og tiltag i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen i La Viva.

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du allerede har erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen og meget gerne i en lignende lederrolle. Vigtigst er dog dit drive, dit værtskab og din evne til at gå forrest som et godt eksempel.

  • Du er udadvendt, smilende og elsker at yde branchens bedste service.

  • Du kan bevare overblikket og træffe hurtige beslutninger, selv når tempoet er højt.

  • Du har en naturlig autoritet og forstår at motivere dine medarbejdere til at yde deres bedste på hver eneste vagt.

  • Du har god forretningsforståelse og stærk sans for købmandskab.

  • Kan tale en eller flere af følgende sprog: Dansk, Engelsk eller Tyrksik.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og udfordrende lederstilling med stor indflydelse på egen arbejdsdag.

  • Et stærkt bagland og en engageret ledelse i La Viva Slagelse ApS, der støtter op om din og restaurantens udvikling.

  • Et dedikeret team af medarbejdere, der glæder sig til at byde deres nye leder velkommen.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer samt gode personalegoder.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Kan du se dig selv i spidsen for La Viva Køge eller Slagelse? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV til os hurtigst muligt. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den helt rette kandidat til jobbet.

Vi får løbende har brug for samme kompetencer i en af vores andre afdelinger i Danmark.

Vi glæder os meget til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Produktionsmedarbejdere til slibe- eller maler afdeling til nat, aften eller fast weekendhold
jobs.description:
Vil du arbejde i en produktion, hvor du bruger kroppen, arbejder med kompositmaterialer og kan se resultatet af dit arbejde hver dag?

Vi søger produktionsmedarbejdere til vores kunde Integris Composites A/S i Vissenbjerg som producerer beskyttelse/paneler til bl.a. køretøjer, de er leverandører til førende virksomheder inden for bl.a. luftfarts- og forsvarsindustrien.

Om jobbet

Som produktionsmedarbejder i slibe eller maler afdelingen får du en praktisk hverdag, hvor du sliber og efterbehandler, eller sprøjtemaler kompositpaneler, så de lever op til virksomhedens kvalitetskrav. Du arbejder med emner i forskellige størrelser og skal sikre, at de er klar til videre produktion.

Du bliver en del af et produktionsteam, hvor kvalitet, stabilitet og godt samarbejde betyder noget. Arbejdet er fysisk aktivt, og du skal derfor trives med at stå op og arbejde gennem størstedelen af dagen.

Dine opgaver

  • Slibe og efterbehandle kompositpaneler

  • Sprøjtemaling af paneler

  • Klargøre og bearbejde emner til videre produktion

  • Udføre kvalitetskontrol af eget arbejde

  • Sikre, at emnerne lever op til de fastlagte kvalitetskrav

  • Løse andre forefaldende produktionsopgaver

Hvad vi tilbyder

Du får en grundig oplæring i arbejdsopgaverne og bliver en del af et team, hvor I hjælper hinanden med at holde produktionen i gang. Der er fokus på oplæring, kvalitet, sikkerhed og et godt samarbejde i hverdagen.

En fastansættelse med en startløn på 175 kr i timen og efter 3 måneder stiger du til 195 kr i timen plus + diverse overenskomstmæssige tillæg, pension og fritvalgskonto. Du får desuden mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling i en virksomhed i vækst.

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed med et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er plads til både faglighed, humor og godt samarbejde. Her er der fokus på arbejdsglæde og trivsel i hverdagen og på sociale arrangementer, der styrker sammenholdet gennem året.

Arbejdstider

Vi søger medarbejdere til tre faste hold:

  • Fast nathold: mandag til torsdag, kl. 21.25–06.15

  • Fast aftenhold: mandag til torsdag 13.55-22.25

  • Fast weekendhold: lørdag og søndag, kl. 06.00–18.00

Oplæringen foregår på dag- og aftenhold.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger dig, der trives med praktisk arbejde, tydelige opgaver og en hverdag, hvor du kan se, hvad du har nået. Du møder stabilt, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og bidrager til, at teamet kan regne med dig i den daglige drift.

Det er nødvendigt, at du:

  • Trives med fysisk arbejde og gentagne opgaver

  • Har sans for kvalitet og detaljer

  • Arbejder omhyggeligt, følger instruktioner og holder fokus på opgaven

  • Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med andre

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra produktion eller lignende praktisk arbejde. Har du erfaring med slibning, er det en stor fordel, men det er ikke et krav. Vi oplærer dig i opgaverne, hvis du har den rette indstilling og lyst til at lære.

Det vil derudover være en stor fordel hvis du har epoxy bevis, eller som minimum er indstillet på at tage det snarest efter opstart.

Er det dig?

Hvis du kan se dig selv i et praktisk produktionsjob, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og fysisk arbejde fylder meget, vil vi gerne høre fra dig. Send dit CV via ansøgningsknappen – vi behandler ansøgninger løbende.

Vil du vide mere?

Skriv til Trine Jørgensen på tjo@medarbejderne, eller ring på 44124986, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen. 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Medarbejderne ApS er et veldrevet vikar-og rekrutteringsfirma, som med baggrund i en sund forretningsfilosofi og høj etisk standard er en stærk aktør på det danske marked. 

Vi har mere end 20 års erfaring med vikar- og rekrutteringsløsninger på alle niveauer og sætter en ære i at skabe kontakt mellem arbejdsgiver og arbejdstager. Medarbejderne ApS er landsdækkende og repræsenteret med kontorer i Horsens, Fredericia, Viborg, Hjørring, Hobro, Odense, Aabenraa, og Ringsted. Vi har ingen ambition om at blive Danmarks største vikar- og rekrutteringsfirma, men om at være det bedste!

Medarbejderne ApS varetager rekrutteringen på vegne af Integris Composites A/S. Vi hjælper virksomheder og kandidater med at finde det rette match gennem vikar- og rekrutteringsløsninger.
