jobs.title: Postdoctoral Position in Intelligent Computing Architectures
jobs.description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a one-year postdoctoral researcher position within Intelligent Computing Architectures, focusing on Hardware-Aware Quantum Machine Learning. The appointment runs for one year from March 1, 2027, with the possibility of extension subject to available funding.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to design, optimize, and evaluate hybrid quantum-classical learning systems under realistic hardware constraints. The project is platform-independent and will investigate how noise, limited quantum resources, device connectivity, and classical computational overhead affect learning performance and practical implementation.

Possible research directions include hardware-aware model design and training, quantum-classical ensemble learning and mixture-of-experts, resource-efficient learning methods, and automated architecture search. The specific research programme will be defined with the successful applicant according to their expertise and the project objectives, with a focused and achievable scope for the initial year. Evaluation will include suitable classical baselines and explicit assessment of computational resource requirements.

The successful candidate will work on model design, quantum programming, simulation, training, and experimental evaluation of hybrid quantum-classical learning systems. The position includes collaboration with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners, identifying relevant research and implementation opportunities, and supporting joint activities. The candidate will also contribute to research proposals and funding applications related to quantum machine learning, intelligent computing architectures, and resource-efficient computing, as well as publications, technical documentation, and project reporting. The research will be supervised by Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio.

 

As a Postdoc in Hardware-Aware Quantum Machine Learning, your key responsibilities will be to:

  • Design, implement, and simulate hybrid quantum-classical learning models, investigating the effects of noise, connectivity, finite sampling, resource limitations, and training conditions. Explore suitable methods such as hardware-aware training, ensemble learning, mixture-of-experts, or architecture search within the agreed research program.

  • Conduct reproducible experimental evaluations of learning performance, trainability, noise resilience, and computational resource requirements using quantum programming frameworks and machine learning tools. Compare results with suitable classical baselines and correlate observed behavior with model design and hardware constraints.

  • Support collaboration with Danish and international academic, industrial, and technology-development partners in quantum machine learning and intelligent computing architectures, identify relevant research and implementation opportunities, contribute to joint activities, and prepare research proposals, funding applications, publications, technical documentation, and project reports.

 

What we offer 

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing section integrating expertise in analog/digital IC design, spintronics, advanced computing, semiconductor technologies, and energy-efficient system architectures. 

  • An opportunity to develop a platform-independent research program in hardware-aware quantum machine learning, combining quantum programming, simulation, and machine learning methods with resource-aware evaluation.

  • Opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with national and international academic and industrial partners in quantum machine learning, microelectronics, AI accelerators, and advanced computing.

  • Strong support for professional development through the Lecturer Training Programme and mentoring, as well as opportunities to develop experience in research proposal writing, project development, and collaboration with Danish and European technology partners. 

  • An open and collaborative research culture within SDU’s Faculty of Engineering (TEK), at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME), supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, computing architectures, quantum computing, and artificial intelligence.

 

What we expect 

Applicants should hold a PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Quantum Computing, Machine Learning, or a closely related field (the degree should have been completed within the last 6 years at most): 

  • Demonstrated experience in quantum programming using frameworks such as Qiskit, PennyLane, or equivalent tools, including implementation and simulation of quantum circuits.

  • Demonstrated experience in machine learning, including model implementation, training, and evaluation, with strong programming skills. Experience in quantum machine learning, hybrid quantum-classical models, noise-aware optimization, ensemble methods, or automated architecture search is an advantage.

  • A strong research track record demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications and the ability to work effectively in collaborative research environments. Experience in writing research proposals, funding applications, or project plans is highly desirable.

  • Team player with strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners across Denmark and Europe. 

All candidates must demonstrate excellent verbal and written English skills, along with very good communication abilities and the ability to communicate technical results to multidisciplinary and international partners. 

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, semiconductor technologies, spintronics, photonics, and advanced computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. The postdoc will work with Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio on hardware-aware quantum machine learning, with opportunities to connect this research to the section’s expertise in AI accelerators and energy-efficient computing architectures.

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Odense. 

 

Further information 

For further information about the research and the position, please contact Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio (chisio@sdu.dk), research contact and supervisor. Additional enquiries may be directed to Professor Farshad Moradi (moradi@sdu.dk), Head of the SDU Microelectronics section. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is December 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial one-year period, and the preferred start date is from March 1, 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Research Assistant in Learning Design
jobs.description:
The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a Research Assistant position. The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is for 12 months.

The position is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and is part of PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education, a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU).

CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.

 

About the position

Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed.

This position sits where those ideas become things people can actually use. You will take responsibility for designing and creating content — reusable set of pedagogical modules that instructors can adopt without redesigning a whole course — and for the hands-on work of redesigning selected software engineering courses at SDU. The project’s research produces findings; this role turns them into activities, materials, rubrics, and guidance that survive contact with a real semester. Implementation is iterative rather than one-shot. Modules go into classrooms, evidence comes back through classroom interventions, surveys, artifact analysis, and educator feedback, and the next version is better for it. If you like building educational material and watching it improve under real use — and you would rather serve teaching than only write about it — this is a role with unusually visible results. Responsibility and opportunities

Concretely, you can expect to:

  • Design and produce reusable pedagogical modules — guided scenarios, reflection and verification activities, assessment tasks, rubrics, and instructor guidance — that courses can adopt on demand.

  • Redesign selected SE courses at SDU. Work with course responsibles and programme leaders to rework intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment so that responsible AI use is explicitly taught and examined.

  • Coordinate classroom deployments across semesters, keeping instructors supported and the logistics from eating the pedagogy.

  • Gather and act on evidence. Administer surveys, analyze student artifacts (decision notes, verification evidence, reflections), collect structured educator feedback, and feed it into the next iteration.

  • Document and release. Maintain the toolkit as open, well-documented material others can pick up after the project ends, and contribute to project reporting and publications.

 

Required scientific qualifications

  • A master’s degree, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree, on Game Development and Learning Technology, Design and Interaction, Educational Technology, Media and Communication, or a closely related field. The degree must be completed before the starting date — this is a firm requirement.

Qualifications Required

  • Demonstrated experience creating educational content — course materials, learning modules, exercises, assessment tasks, e-learning components, or training programmes — with examples you can show us. Please, share a link to your portfolio if available.

  • An educational or pedagogical background, whether through your degree, formal training in teaching or learning design, or substantial practical experience.

  • Excellent written and spoken Danish and English, and the ability to write clearly for two audiences at once: students and the instructors who will use your materials.

Personal competences

  • Craft in making things others will use. You care whether an activity actually works in week seven of a busy semester, not only whether it reads well in a design document.

  • A service orientation towards instructors. Course responsibles own their courses and have limited time. We value someone who makes adoption easy and earns agreement through evidence and patience rather than argument.

  • Organized and self-directed. You will be coordinating deployments across courses at SDU and several semesters, and much of the scheduling discipline will rest with you.

  • Comfort with iteration. The first version of a module will be wrong in interesting ways. Treating that as information rather than failure is most of the job.

  • Integrity and care in working with students. You will be collecting data from people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.

 

Workplace description 

The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at SDU’s Faculty of Engineering. We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously.

You will be based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg, sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The international community is sizeable, thanks to the university and the global companies based nearby, and Copenhagen is a 35-minute flight or a direct train away. Two good starting points: VisitSønderborg for the area itself, and Hej Sønderborg, an English-language blog written for newcomers about living here.

 

Further information 

Further information about the position contact Associate Professor Adam Alami, at adal@mmmi.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Complete list of publications, if you have any.

  • Publications most relevant for the position (max. 2).

  • Up to two references (can be supplied later in the hiring process).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is December 9, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment termsAppointment as a research assistant is temporary for an initial 1-year period, and the preferred start date is from March 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. 

Employment as a research assistant requires qualifications at minimum master’s level (equivalent to a Danish master’s degree) at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for research assistant as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. jobs.title: Postdoc and Assistant Professor Positions in Communications, Radar Systems, and Antenna Design
jobs.description:
Would you like to advance wireless connectivity and radar sensing for intelligent devices and autonomous systems? The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one or more Postdoc (2 years) and/or Assistant Professor positions in Communications, Signal Processing, Radar Systems, and Antenna Design. Join a growing research environment connecting electronic systems research with applications in robotics, drones, defence technology, and the Internet of Things (IoT). The preferred starting date is February 1, 2027.

 

Job Content

Your research will advance communications, signal processing, radar systems, and antenna design, with a focus on real-time wireless connectivity, physical-layer technologies, and antennas for intelligent devices, IoT systems, and edge computers. The scope spans 5G, mmWave, terahertz technologies, 6G and beyond, LoRa, software-defined radio, and integrated sensing, including communication protocols, modulation techniques, and antenna design and implementation. Applications include autonomous collaborative robotics, drone swarm communications, radar-based object detection and tracking, low-power radio sensor networks, and defence technology.

You will have the opportunity to connect your research with the section’s complementary expertise in FPGA and neuromorphic computing, edge AI, machine learning, sensing technologies, and energy harvesting. Working with academic colleagues and professional staff across SDU campuses, you will contribute to a collaborative research community and the development of academic programmes.

Postdoc: You will conduct research within the position’s scope, contribute to course planning, support teaching, and supervise Bachelor’s and Master’s students in relevant fields. You will also support the research team in developing applications for external funding.

Assistant Professor: You will develop and sustain a research agenda that strengthens or complements the section’s activities, secure external research funding, and publish in reputable journals and international conference proceedings. You will plan and teach Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses in communications, radar and sensor technologies, and antenna theory and practice, while advising and mentoring students and supervising their research projects. You will also contribute to academic service at section and department levels, participate in professional activities and conferences locally, nationally, and internationally, and undertake other duties assigned by the Section Chair.

 

Required Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD degree in Electronics, Communications, or a closely related field. Your application must document the following qualifications:

  • Research expertise relevant to the position in communications, signal processing, or antenna design.

  • Demonstrated potential to teach Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses at university level.

  • For Assistant Professor applicants, pedagogical and subject-specific skills appropriate to the position’s teaching and research responsibilities.

International research experience gained in an environment other than the institution where the applicant completed their PhD will be considered an advantage. 

 

Workplace description 

The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics brings together research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communications. Using advanced reconfigurable computing and sensing technologies, we develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions for autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grids, and healthcare. This breadth creates opportunities to connect fundamental research with practical engineering challenges. 

Our research is organized into four complementary areas: 1) Infrastructure Inspection and Maintenance, 2) Bio-inspired Intelligent Systems, 3) High-Frequency Power Management, and 4) Radar Remote Sensing. The section is growing steadily and comprises 15 staff members, including professors, PhD students, and engineers, who contribute to research, industrial collaboration, and education. We play a central role in electrical engineering education in Odense, contributing to Bachelor’s and Master of Science programmes in Electronics Engineering. 

SDU’s Odense campus brings together six faculties, with a large university hospital soon to join the campus environment, creating opportunities for interdisciplinary research and a vibrant student life. Odense offers a culturally rich setting with a growing robotics community, attractive residential areas, and green spaces along the river through the city centre. 

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU.

 

Further information 

To learn more about the positions and research environment, please contact Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, Head of the Section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics, at esme@sdu.dk. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

We welcome applications outlining how your expertise and research ambitions would contribute to the section. Please submit your application in English and include the following documents: 

  • A motivation letter describing your interest in the position, relevant qualifications, and reasons for joining the section (maximum 2 pages).

  • A detailed curriculum vitae, including contact information, research experience, teaching experience, computational skills, and other relevant qualifications.

  • For Assistant Professor applicants: a Teaching Portfolio documenting your teaching qualifications and experience. 

  • For Assistant Professor applicants: a research plan outlining your proposed research direction and plans for developing a research line, securing external funding, and building a research team. 

  • For Postdoc applicants: a brief research plan outlining your proposed research focus, approach, and expected contributions during the two-year appointment, including its alignment with the position and the section’s activities. 

  • PhD, Master’s and     Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent (original     and an official English translation). 

  • A list of publications, with the most relevant     publications highlighted.  

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Names and email addresses of up to three     researchers who can provide an informed reference at short notice.     Reference letters and documentation of other relevant qualifications may     also be included.  

  • A statement/documentation     of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

 

The application deadline is December 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

The appointments are temporary for an initial 2-year period (for the postdoc position) or 3-year period (for the assistant professor position). Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.  

Employment as a postdoctoral fellow and assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for either postdoc or assistant professor as described therein.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team i Nordjylland.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør.

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

     står for sidemandsoplæring af rengøringspersonale

•   Er humoristisk anlagt og kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

•   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale på et rimeligt niveau

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

jobs.title: Restaurant Manager

Tandoori Twist is an offering from Tinyhus Cafe, a child-friendly cafe in Copenhagen, Denmark, serving authentic Indian delicacies. 

We serve not only classic favourites like butter chicken and biriyani, but also lesser known Indian regional food, with myriad of spices and flavours as our specilities.

Our cafe Tinyhus serves continental food, also traditional local cuisines for events and catering. 

We strive to provide authentic food and exceptional service to our guests and we look for team members who are self-motivated, proactive and passionate to walk the extra mile to provide exceptional culinery experience for our guests. 

Our people, just like our food, are the ambassadors of our cafe and restaurant. If you like challenges and you are looking for a place where you can contribute positively, overcoming the odds of a new but growing restaurant, then please do get in touch; we will look forward to hear from you.

Job Description - Restaurant Manager –Indian Dining Experience

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on Restaurant Manager to take full ownership of our service. If you have a passion for authentic Indian cuisine and the drive to build a high-performance culture, we will look forward to welcome you to lead our team.

This is not a back-office role. We are looking for a visible leader who thrives on the floor, inspires the team, and ensures every guest leaves with a memorable experience.

Service ownership: Take complete charge of the dining room, ensuring service personnel are attentive, aligned, and delivering our high-quality service standards.

Who We Are Looking For:

· Experience: 3–4 years of proven leadership experience in the hospitality industry is essential.

· Cuisine Expertise: Deep knowledge of Indian cuisine is essential; prior management experience in an Indian restaurant is highly preferred.

· Language: High-level fluency in English.

jobs.title: Arbejd med fødevaresikkerhed: Bliv tilsynstekniker i Kødkontrollen ved Tican i Brørup
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at højne fødevaresikkerheden i Danmark, så er der mulighed for at blive en del af et fagligt dygtigt team ved Fødevarestyrelsens Kødkontrol ved Tican Fresh Meat A/S i Brørup. Om jobbet Som tilsynstekniker er din primære opgave post mortem-kontrol af slagtesvin. Kontrollen foregår som båndkontrol, hvor der i øjeblikket slagtes på én linje med en hastighed af 760 enheder i timen på både daghold og aftenhold. Foruden din primære opgave, vil du også kunne beskæftige dig med;
  • Andre tilsynsopgaver og prøveudtagning.
  • Diverse praktiske opgaver, som hører med til afdelingens dagligdag.
  • Deltagelse i afdelingsmøder, teammøder og interne kurser.
Om dig Vi leder efter dig, der er uddannet tilsynstekniker og som befinder sig godt i rollen som myndighedsperson. Vi ønsker os tilmed en kollega, som bidrager med godt humør, er fleksibel, hjælpsom og har gode samarbejdsevner. Vi lægger vægt på, at du;
  • Er fagligt interesseret og omhyggelig i dit arbejde
  • Er indstillet på at kompetenceudvikle dig, når der sker ændringer i regler og procedurer
  • Er klar til at give og modtage konstruktiv feedback, så vi sammen kan nå vores mål om at udvikle den bedste kødkontrol
  • Kan kommunikere på dansk
  • Har grundlæggende IT-kundskaber
Om os Styrelsen for Fødevarer, Landbrug og Fiskeri er en statslig organisation med stor samfundsmæssig betydning. Vi arbejder for, at fødevarer er sikre, og at dyr behandles forsvarligt. Kødkontrollen kontrollerer alle slagtedyr på danske slagterier og har fokus på smitsomme sygdomme, dyrevelfærd og fødevaresikkerhed. I vores sektion er vi ca. 48 medarbejdere – vi er dyrlæger, tilsynsteknikere, administrativt personale, elever, timelønnede og 1 sektionsleder. Vi spænder bredt i aldersfordeling og erfaringsgrundlag, og vi ser det som en styrke at få vores forskellige kompetencer i spil, så vi i fællesskab kan løse kerneopgaven. Vi har et kontinuerligt fokus på at optimere kvaliteten af kontrollen samtidig med, at vi er tilpasningsklar som følge af, at vi er en politisk styret organisation. Det praktiske Der er tale om faste fuldtidsstillinger på 37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse snarest muligt. Ansættelsesområdet er Fødevarestyrelsen. Tjenestestedet er Kødkontrollen ved Tican Fresh Meat A/S i Brørup, Markedsvej 9, 6650 Brørup. Virksomheden slagter både dag og aften og arbejdstiden i Kødkontrollen er derfor på daghold fra kl. 6.00 til kl. 14.00 mens arbejdstiden på aftenholdet er fra kl. 14.00 til kl. 21.15. Vi roterer mellem dag- og aftenhold, således at man hver anden uge arbejder aftenhold og tilsvarende hver anden uge arbejder daghold. Ansættelsen sker efter gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer samt organisationsaftale for tilsynsfunktionærer ved eksportautoriserede slagterier. Til tilsynsfunktionærer, der har gennemført uddannelsen som tilsynstekniker, gives et pensionsgivende teknikertillæg på 3.948 kr. pr. måned. Herudover indplaceres tilsynsteknikere på en basisløn på enten 27.972 kr. pr. måned (1. og 2. år) eller 28.389 kr. pr. måned (3. og følgende år). Herudover vil det være muligt at forhandle et kvalifikationstillæg alt efter den enkeltes kvalifikationer i relation til stillingen. Pensionsbidraget for tilsynsfunktionærer udgør 13,68 %. Sådan kontakter du os og søger stillingen Vi glæder os til at modtage din motiverede ansøgning, CV, kopi af eksamensbevis og eventuelle andre relevante bilag senest den 23. november 2026. Du søger stillingen ved at sende en mail til kkhr@fvst.dk med emnefeltet: ”Ansøgning til stillingen som tilsynstekniker i Brørup”. Du opfordres til at læse mere om Fødevarestyrelsen på www.fvst.dk. Fødevarestyrelsen betragter mangfoldighed som et aktiv og opfordrer alle uanset baggrund til at søge.

We seek an exceptional researcher with demonstrated excellence in their discipline and a proven ability to push boundaries, challenge conventions, and engage in groundbreaking interdisciplinary research. The successful candidate will be expected to contribute to cutting-edge advancements in their field while fostering collaboration across disciplines, embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven research. The ideal candidate will have a strong international research profile, an outstanding record of attracting competitive research funding, and a demonstrated ability to conduct interdisciplinary research. The successful candidate will be attached to the Department of Clinical Research, DIAS, and the Region, and must be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU and in the Region of Southern Denmark. 

What we offer

  • The opportunity to lead a new elite centre for clinical and translational psychiatry, with five-year funding of DKK 17 million (equivalent to Euro 2.3 million), with the potential for a five-year extension.

  • A strong interdisciplinary research environment through DIAS, comprising leading academics across medicine, science, and the humanities, with the opportunity to collaborate with outstanding researchers across SDU’s five faculties.

  • Access to state-of-the-art research facilities at the newly built Odense University Hospital (OUH), where psychiatry and somatic care are integrated to foster collaboration between these fields.

  • Comprehensive research support services from DIAS and SDU, targeting prestigious funding such as DNRF, ERC, and grants from Danish private foundations.

  • If recruited from abroad or from industry, the candidate will be eligible for a fast-track DKK 11 million  (equivalent to Euro 1.5 million ) Lundbeck Foundation Start-Up grant.

  • Reduced teaching obligations compared to a standard professorship, allowing the candidate to focus on research and leadership within the elite centre.

Who we are looking for 

We are seeking a highly accomplished researcher with expertise in the field of clinical translational psychiatry, who is eager to engage in collaborative activities within the DIAS framework. 

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

  • A record of internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Publications in high-level peer-reviewed academic journals and leading innovative research programmes in clinical psychiatry. 

  • An ability to attract significant external funding to support independent and collaborative research initiatives.

  • Engagement in the international academic society. 

  • Extensive experience in building and leading multidisciplinary research teams that integrate basic and clinical sciences, with an emphasis on translational research spanning from laboratory findings to clinical trials.

  • A research focus in areas such as child and adolescent psychiatry, clinical psychopharmacology, epidemiology, molecular neurobiology, substance use disorders, or serious mental illness.

  • The ability to develop a translational research programme in one or more of the mentioned fields, with a focus on building cooperative, multidisciplinary teams that bridge basic science and the design and execution of early-phase clinical trials.

  • A demonstrated commitment to mentorship, teaching, and leadership, fostering the next generation of researchers in interdisciplinary research environments.

  • Experience at Full or Associate Professor level within relevant fields.

  • Fluency in English

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, mentor DIAS fellows, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.  

The Department of Clinical Research

The Department of Clinical Research does translational research spanning from basic research to patient care, within both somatics and psychiatry. The interdisciplinary research aims to improve patient treatment, health, and well-being. Researchers at the institute often have joint appointments between clinic, research, and education, ensuring a strong academic foundation for the research at Odense University Hospital (OUH) and in psychiatry. The researchers at the Department of Clinical Research primarily consist of doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals with main employment at OUH.

The Centre for Clinical and Translational PsychiatryThe centre will be based at the new Odense University Hospital, which integrates psychiatric and somatic care to promote close collaboration between the fields. The hospital includes a state-of-the-art adult psychiatric department with around 600 employees, 142 single rooms, and specialized sections for joint somatic-psychiatric care, rehabilitation, telepsychiatry, and more. The child and adolescent psychiatric department cover the entire region with about 600 employees, two inpatient wards with a total of 34 beds, and outpatient clinics at four geographical sites.The centre’s aim is to advance novel psychiatric research through innovative approaches that will significantly impact future patient care. This includes translating discoveries from the laboratory to clinical settings, whether within narrow clinical fields or through broader cross-disciplinary collaborations that involve various clinical functions, professions, and institutions.

Additional informationFor further information about being a professor at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk For further information and questions about the position, please contact the Head of the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen at +456550 3477 or via email at rllarsen@health.sdu.dk or Medical Director Bjarne Dahler-Eriksen, Odense University Hospital, at +4523284068 or via email at bde@rsyd.dk. You may also contact the Vice Dean for Research and Innovation at the Faculty of Health Sciences, SDU, Uffe Holmskov at +45 6550 3775 or via email at uholmskov@health.sdu.dk regarding the position.

Application, salary, and employment terms

This position will be attached to the Department of Clinical Research in Odense. The successful candidate will be expected to regularly engage in DIAS activities and interdisciplinary cooperation in Odense. 

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

For more details on salary and taxation, please refer to the provided links about salary and taxation.

Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

Application requirements

Applications must be submitted electronically via the "Apply now" link provided below.

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

The application must include the following:

  • A motivation letter.

  • A detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV), including contacts for possible references.

  • Copies of relevant certificates/diplomas.

  • A teaching portfolio detailing previous teaching experience.

  • A complete list of publications, highlighting those most relevant to the position.

  • Up to ten of the most relevant publications

  • A research and publication plan for the next five years, including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

Submission guidelines

  • Files must be submitted in PDF format, with each file no larger than 10 MB.

  • If multiple files are needed for a single section, combine them into one PDF file.

  • Zip files, image files (jpg, png, etc.), and password-protected PDF files will not be accepted. All PDF files must be unlocked to allow binding.

  • The application deadline is February 7, 2027, at 23:59 CET. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

Applications that are incomplete with regards to the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed by the committee. Shortlisting and tests may be used in the recruitment process and references may be obtained.  

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit the websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you will find information and facts about moving to, working, and living in Denmark.

Assessment

Shortlisting may be used as part of the recruitment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material.  

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.

About SDU

SDU is committed to fostering a diverse staff that reflects society’s diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background.

SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. While SDU’s main campus is in Odense, it also has campuses in other locations.Equal opportunity employment

The University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. 

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to several security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Contractor
jobs.description:
About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

  • Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!

You will need:

  • Home office or a quiet place to work.

  • Strong internet connection.

  • Desktop or laptop

(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)

Scheduling

Training: The schedule for the first four weeks of our training period is 10 AM - 6 PM EST.

*The first week of training is mandatory for all new trainees. If a day is missed you may be asked to restart the first week of training.

jobs.title: Revenue Cycle Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

We are fixing US healthcare by building an AI-native physical care platform, starting with home health.

Home health is a $140B industry with less than $10B in EBITDA â 40% of revenue is spent on pure administrative waste. We automate this work with AI, creating a fundamentally different cost structure compared to incumbents. This lets us rapidly take market share by serving the 30% of patients who go untreated today.

By reshaping the cost structure of this industry, we unlock its growth.

We've built one of the best AI teams in the world (from Character AI, Scale, Palantir, Citadel, Jane Street) and paired them with a team of healthcare veterans to build a new type of healthcare company: one that delivers care at the speed of an AI company.

Our physical care platform already operates with 30pp higher gross margins than traditional home health providers. With our AI advantage, we pay nurses more, remove their admin burden, and unlock the scale economics that have been missing from this fragmented industry. If we served this entire $140B market, instead of $10B in EBITDA, we'd drive $60B.

We're starting with home health, then expanding to all delivered care. Our mission is "any care, any where".

Fundamentally, our incentives are aligned with America. Every dollar in revenue we make is two dollars taken out of the healthcare system. If we succeed, so does US healthcare.

Role overview

Weâre seeking a hands-on Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Manager to lead and support a team of specialists in a home health environment. This manager will stay close to daily operations, monitor team performance, and respond quickly to questions and emerging issues to help the team meet its goals. The role focuses on accounts receivable (AR), helping the team move outstanding claims from follow-up to verified resolution.

What Youâll Do

  • Manage and support RCM specialists working across home health revenue cycle workflows.

  • Track attendance and monitor individual and team performance against established KPIs and daily quotas.

  • Review workflow boards throughout the day to spot backlogs, red flags, and specialists at risk of missing their end-of-day quotas.

  • Respond promptly to specialist questions while balancing real-time workflow monitoring and other team needs.

  • Identify process gaps and work with the team to resolve issues affecting daily performance.

  • Apply your home health and Homecare Homebase (HCHB) knowledge to help specialists navigate workflows and resolve operational questions.

Accounts receivable and collections

  • Guide specialists and team leads in prioritizing assigned commercial, Medicare, and Medicare Advantage receivables, including aged balances, payer responses, rejections, denials, and upcoming filing or appeal deadlines.

  • Oversee claim follow-up through resolution: verify claim status and payment, investigate collection barriers and underpayments, and guide appropriate corrections, reprocessing, reconsiderations, or appeals under payer-specific requirements.

  • Review and respond to escalations when a specialist cannot determine the next action; surface recurring payer, workflow, or system issues to leadership and coordinate their resolution.

  • Ensure claim activity, supporting evidence, next actions, and follow-up dates are documented accurately in the applicable AR workflow and HCHB.

  • Partner with billing, payment posting, prior authorization, clinical, and other teams to resolve discrepancies, obtain documentation, and follow paid-but-not-posted claims through resolution.

  • Review proposed write-offs for documented collection efforts and supporting evidence, and route them through the required approval and posting process.

Quality and team development

  • Review claim work for accurate denial interpretation, appropriate action, complete documentation, timely follow-up, and correct escalation; use findings to coach specialists and strengthen performance.

  • Support onboarding, payer and system cross-training, and regular knowledge sharing. Identify patterns behind collection challenges and update SOPs or workflows to prevent repeat issues.

  • Share frontline feedback on AR dashboards and automation with relevant teams to improve prioritization, visibility, and specialist workflows.

Basic Qualifications

  • Strong experience in home health revenue cycle operations.

  • Familiarity with Homecare Homebase (HCHB).

  • Experience managing RCM specialists, including tracking attendance and performance KPIs.

  • Experience monitoring workflows throughout the day and identifying risks to daily productivity targets.

  • Experience identifying collection challenges and implementing processes to resolve.

  • Working knowledge of AR follow-up, denial investigation, appeals or reprocessing, and payer-specific filing requirements.

  • Experience reviewing claim documentation and quality, escalating unresolved issues, and coordinating with billing or posting teams.

  • Ability to respond promptly to team questions while managing multiple priorities.

  • Ability to identify workflow or process gaps and help the team address them.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing distributed or offshore revenue cycle teams.

  • Familiarity with commercial fee-for-service and Medicare or Medicare Advantage home health claims, including episodic/PDGM workflows.

  • Experience with AR dashboards, clearinghouses, and payer portals such as Waystar and Availity.

  • Experience using denial trends, quality reviews, or operational data to improve collections workflows and team training.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary

  • Comprehensive health insurance, dental, and commuter benefits

  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer contribution

  • Opportunity for growth in a fast-growing company

  • Collaborative team valuing innovation and problem-solving

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

The role

Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.

You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.

You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

  • Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

  • Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

  • Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

  • Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

  • Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.

  • Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.

  • Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.

  • Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.

  • Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.

  • Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.

  • Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.

Your background

You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:

  • A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.

  • Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.

  • Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.

  • A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role.

  • A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant.

  • Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus.

You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦

  • Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, iterating quickly, and fixing things before they become fires;

  • Stay Human. You care deeply about users and teammates, and design with empathy for real workflows;

  • Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs. You spot problems early and take initiative to fix them.

  • Keep It Simple. You fight unnecessary complexity, design reusable patterns, and make hard things feel intuitive.

  • Love to Surprise. You enjoy finding unexpected ways to delight users, especially in the last mile of polish and usability.

KPIs & Success Measures

We will measure success through outcomes and quality, not just output:

  • Builder share (lead): percentage of monthly active users who build or edit a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

  • Workflow adoption (lead): percentage of monthly active users who run a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

  • Workflow run growth: month-on-month percentage growth in workflow runs. Target [TBD]%.

  • First workflow conversion: percentage of new users who complete a successful run within their first [TBD] days.

  • Share of generations through workflows: percentage of all generations produced by workflow runs.

  • Agent and human collaboration: percentage of workflow runs built or started by Scribble.

  • Connector adoption: percentage of active workspaces that use at least one third-party connection in a workflow each month. Target [TBD]%.

  • Integration usage: percentage of workflow runs that start from, or deliver to, a third-party connection. Target [TBD]%.

  • Reliability (hygiene bar): percentage of runs that complete without manual intervention, held at or above [TBD]%.

  • Learning velocity (supporting): percentage of launches reviewed after release against their stated hypothesis. Target 100%.

Benefits

  • 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme

  • Health insurance / private medical cover

  • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development

  • Remote - work from anywhere in your home country

  • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

  • Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for our UK employees

  • Flexible working hours

Deep Dive About Pencil

Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI.

We're called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past.

Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500.

https://www.trypencil.com

About The Brandtech Group

The Brandtech Group's mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology.

It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022.

Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. Clients include Banco ItaÃº, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan-Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever.

In addition, the Group invests in cutting-edge technology companies relevant to and with potential in marketing and has been investing in the AI, AR and the metaverse space since 2015. The Group was the first external investor in Niantic (creators of PokÃ©mon Go), alongside investments in AI Foundation (AI digital twins, personalized AI, and deep-fake detection 2018), Automat (AI chatbots, 2016), Elsy (AI media planning, 2016), Jivox (dynamic automated content, 2016), Crossing Minds (deep learning AI recommendation system, 2017), CreativeX (AI-driven content optimization, 2022), Zappar (AR, 2017), Provenance (blockchain, 2022) and GGP (the world's largest gaming fund).

The Group is one of the most prominent marketing industry voices on the prediction and movement to AI-driven marketing, including Generative AI. It was named one of the World's Most Innovative Companies 2021 by Fast Company, and by CB Insights as one of the World's Most Valuable Private Unicorns.

About RainFocus

Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun and exciting. 

 

About the Role

As a Jr. UI Developer, you will be an essential part of our team, assisting in the implementation of stunning, user-friendly web applications. Working alongside experienced developers, you will use HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript to help translate designs into high-quality web experiences for our events and platforms. This position is ideal for an early-career developer who is passionate about visually-focused development, eager to learn best practices in CSS and JavaScript, and excited to collaborate within a supportive team environment. You will gain hands-on experience with branding, workflows, and enterprise-grade software development.

\n


How you will contribute:

  • Assist in developing, updating, and maintaining UI components and branding with a strong focus on design and responsiveness.

  • Collaborate closely with senior developers, designers, and Product Management to learn processes and deliver quality work.

  • Write clean, maintainable HTML, CSS (using SASS and utility classes), and basic JavaScript (including exposure to React and Svelte).

  • Help troubleshoot, debug, and fix styling issues or UI-related bugs across different browsers and devices.

  • Participate in code reviews to receive feedback, learn RainFocus coding standards, and improve your skills.

  • Support the team in configuring client white-labeling, templates, and basic event workflows.


Required Experience/ Skills:

  • 1â2 years of professional web development experience, or equivalent experience through bootcamps, internships, or robust portfolio projects.

  • Solid fundamental knowledge of HTML, CSS, and CSS preprocessors like SASS.

  • Basic understanding of vanilla JavaScript and an eagerness to learn modern frameworks like React and Svelte.

  • Understanding of responsive design principles and cross-browser compatibility.

  • Familiarity with version control systems, such as Git.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • A proactive mindset, self-motivated to ask questions, learn, and grow as a developer.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Works well in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Exposure to design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or Photoshop.

  • Basic awareness of web accessibility (WCAG) standards.

  • Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.

  • General understanding of how APIs or backend systems (like Java) interact with front-end code.


\n

Why work at RainFocus?

At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

 

As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. 

 

What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

We are looking for an AI Developer to join and strengthen our AI department. Solid DevOps fundamentals - Docker, CI/CD, Azure - support this work, but AI engineering is the heart of the role.

You'll work closely with our engineering and product teams to take LLM-powered features from prototype to reliably deployed systems, with mentorship available as you ramp up in areas like RAG architecture, Kafka, and advanced MCP work.

Key Responsibilities

AI / LLM Engineering (core focus)

  • Serve and operate open-source LLMs using Ollama and llama.cpp, locally and in on-prem environments.
  • Build and maintain RAG pipelines: embeddings, vector databases, chunking strategies, and retrieval quality.
  • Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations connecting LLMs to internal tools and data sources.
  • Build backend services in Python that power ML inference and AI-driven product features.
  • Parse and process structured and semi-structured data (XML/XSD, Office document formats) as pipeline inputs.
  • Grow into model optimization over time: quantization (GGUF), GPU/CUDA tuning, and offline/air-gapped deployments.

DevOps & Infrastructure (supporting)

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI services (Azure DevOps preferred; GitHub Actions / GitLab CI also used).
  • Deploy AI workloads to Microsoft Azure,AWS and containerize services with Docker.
  • Automate operational tasks with Python, Bash and/or PowerShell scripting.
  • Troubleshoot across the stack - dig into root causes rather than patching symptoms.
  • Support event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (producers/consumers).
  • 3â5+ years engineering experience with production-level Python for building real services, LLM inference, RAG pipelines, and automated tooling.
  • Hands-on LLM & AI integration serving models via Ollama/llama.cpp, implementing vector retrieval/RAG, and developing MCP integrations (GPU/CUDA tuning & model quantization nice to have).
  • Cloud & Infrastructure expertise covering Azure/AWS deployments, Docker containerization, Linux/Windows admin, and CI/CD automation (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), with Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, or systems languages (Go, Rust, C++) as a plus.
  • DevOps, Security & Operations awareness, including Git workflows, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), observability tools (Prometheus/Grafana), DevSecOps, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, Zero Trust).

jobs.title: Job i udlandet - Job på Cypern - Gaming supporter - Betalt bolig de første 2 måneder.
jobs.description:
Vi søger engagerede gaming eksperter til vores danske gaming support‑team hos en international virksomhed på Cypern. Du bliver en del af en dynamisk organisation med et moderne arbejdsmiljø og mulighed for at opleve den solrige middelhavsø Cypern. Udover værdifuld international erhvervserfaring får du mulighed for at udforske en kultur med stærke traditioner, smukke strande og en afslappet livsstil.

Kvalifikationer

  • Du taler dansk og er komfortabel med at tale og skrive engelsk

  • Du har gode computerfærdigheder

  • Interesse for gaming er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Benefits

  • Fast månedsløn med attraktivt bonussystem

  • Betalt træning og onboarding

  • Relocation‑pakke med flere muligheder:

    • Relocation‑support for kandidater, der flytter til Cypern

    • Mulighed for at modtage €1.500 ved selv at arrangere bolig

    • Alternativ løsning med flykompensation op til €300 og firmabolig i op til to måneder

  • Fordelagtigt skattesystem med 0 % indkomstskat op til €19.500 pr. år

  • Rabatter og tilbud hos lokale restauranter, caféer, fitnesscentre m.m.

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder

  • Moderne, nyrenoveret og centralt beliggende kontor

  • Internationalt arbejdsmiljø

  • Hjælp til administration såsom åbning af bankkonto og migration

  • Månedlige aktivitetsdage, hvor du kan udforske Cypern

  • Support fra teamledere, HR og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

Hvorfor arbejde internationalt?

Et job i en international virksomhed inden for gaming, IT og tech kan åbne døren til betydelige karrieremuligheder. Du får erfaring, der styrker dit CV, udvider dine kompetencer og gør dig attraktiv for fremtidige arbejdsgivere. Samtidig får du mulighed for personlig udvikling og en unik oplevelse i et nyt land.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Kontakt os og bliv en del af vores spændende team på Cypern!

Kontakt os på Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com eller Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com

Du kan også booke en snak med os via dette link: Book et kald

būvstrādniekus darbam būvniecības objektos.

 

Darba pienākumos ietilpst dažādu palīgdarbu veikšana būvobjektā, vienkāršu zemes darbu izpilde, celtniecības materiālu un palīgmateriālu pārvietošana, kā arī būvjavu un betona sastāvu sagatavošana. Darbiniekam būs jāpalīdz būvkonstrukciju uzstādīšanā un demontāžā, jāveic vienkārši mūrēšanas un virsmu sagatavošanas darbi, kā arī jānodrošina būvgružu savākšana un teritorijas sakārtošana.

Darba pienākumi var ietvert arī citus vienkāršus ēku, dzīvojamo, saimniecības vai ražošanas ēku remonta darbus.

No kandidātiem sagaidām atbildīgu attieksmi pret darbu, spēju strādāt komandā un ievērot darba drošības prasības. 

Uzņēmums piedāvā stabilu darbu un regulāru atalgojumu, nodrošina darbam nepieciešamo aprīkojumu, kā arī sniedz profesionālās izaugsmes iespējas un darbu draudzīgā kolektīvā.

jobs.title: French-speaking Sales Executive - Industrial Automation
jobs.description:
Native French speaker, fully remote

Work tasks: Condor Automation is a growing company selling to industrial customers all over Europe. We help factories keep their machines running by finding the automation parts they urgently need: PLCs, HMIs, drives, servo drives, motors, electronic boards and sensors from brands such as Siemens, Omron, Allen Bradley, Fanuc, Mitsubishi, Yaskawa, Schneider and ABB. Our speciality is the obsolete and hard-to-find parts that local distributors can't supply. We are looking for an ambitious French-speaking Sales Executive to help us grow in France and Belgium. This is a real chance to grow with the company: your results will be seen, valued and rewarded. You will: - Find and contact new B2B customers (factories, maintenance teams, OEMs and integrators) by phone and email - Follow up enquiries and quotes and close sales - Build long-term relationships with existing customers - Work closely with the purchasing team to offer fast and competitive quotes - Keep customer and sales activity up to date in our CRM (Odoo)

We offer: - EUR 2,500 gross monthly salary + uncapped commission - there is no limit to what you can earn - Flexible hours: organise your day around your life, while covering our customers' needs - A real work-family balance, with a team that supports you when life happens - Work from home, anywhere in Estonia - 100% remote - Full training on our products, sales techniques and tools - A stable, long-term role with real room to grow as the company grows We are a small, international team spread across the UK, Italy and Spain. We believe people do their best work when their life outside work is looked after too. If you are a parent, you can give your best at work knowing the team has your back when something comes up at home.

Other requirements: The team works in English; you will speak to customers in French. - Native French (essential) - Good working English to communicate with the team - Proven experience in B2B sales of industrial, electrical or automation products - An existing network of industrial customers in France or Belgium is a strong advantage - Confident on the phone and good at following up - Organised, proactive and comfortable working remotely and independently - Technical knowledge of industrial automation is a plus - we will train you on our products - Resident in Estonia

Option to work from home: Yes
